chapters.title: Chapter 269 - Blissful Island
paragraphs: “You didn’t ask me earlier either.”
Han Yan spread his arms and said in a helpless manner.
Haha...
Everyone burst into laughter. As the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, Daoist Black had just drank a dog’s wine. This was not something that other people should know happened.
“Damn you, what’s wrong with this master dog’s wine? Fuck, do you all know how many people dream about having a sip of my leftover wine? This is your lucky day, don’t try to be greedy!”
Big Yellow immediately became angry; he kept shouting at Daoist Black. This dog didn’t care who he was facing, he would even dare challenge the father of the heavenly king.

Daoist Black stared at Big Yellow who seemed like he had just suffered the biggest grievance. His face turned red because of embarrassment, but in the end, he just couldn’t speak any words. If any other dog had dared be so arrogant in front of him, he would definitely have skinned the dog alive. But, this dog was not a dog that could easily be trifled with. Even Duan Jianhong was defeated by him. Putting that aside, Big Yellow and Daoist Black did have a pretty good relationship. With Daoist Black’s current condition, where he hadn’t even fully recovered, perhaps he might even be defeated by this dog.
“Sect Chief, it’s a truth that not anyone can drink Big Yellow’s wine. Today, Brother Yan has finally recovered, and his cultivation has skyrocketed. It’s good news for us, and we should celebrate.”
Jiang Chen hurriedly changed the focus to Han Yan, Giving Daoist Black an excuse to escape from this embarrassing moment.

“Right. Brother Yan is considered a rare genius right now, not only does he have the Ancient Divine Devil’s bloodline, he’s even a peak Mid Divine Core warrior at such a young age. I’m afraid even I am no match for Brother Yan.”

Daoist Black looked at Han Yan with a smile on his face. For him, it was a glorious thing to have so many geniuses in the Black Sect. The future would definitely shine brightly because of these geniuses.
“It’s all because of Little Chen! Come, a toast to my Little Chen!”
Han Yan raised his wine pot and tossed off its lid.
“Damn you, shouldn’t you toast this master dog as well? If not for this master dog, do you really think that guy could have killed the Earth Devil by himself?”
Big Yellow became furious once again.
“Brother Yan, Big Yellow did contribute to the most important part of the trip to Inferno Hell. You should toast him as well.”

Jiang Chen said in a serious manner. If not for Big Yellow coming along with him to Inferno Hell, Jiang Chen would not have been able to kill the Earth Devil in such a smooth manner. Putting aside all other issues, without Big Yellow, there were two things he wouldn’t have been able to accomplish.

First, without Big Yellow, there was no way Jiang Chen could have found the hidden Blood Talisman within Inferno City. Without the Blood Talisman, he couldn’t have handled the powerful Earth Devil. Secondly, without Big Yellow, Jiang Chen wouldn’t have been able to leave the Poisonous Miasma Space. The Spiraling Defense Mechanism Big Yellow mad was extraordinary, and it was the key that allowed Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu to escape from the Poisonous Miasma Space.
“Fine, a toast from me, Han Yan to Big Yellow!”
Han Yan raised the wine pot and gave Big Yellow a toast. Only then did Big Yellow let out a satisfied laugh.

“Jiang Chen, the most important task for us now is to move the Black Sect to Redsun Town. I have already settled everything in the Redsun Town, our next step is to start building. Do you have any ideas how we should proceed with this?”

Daoist Black asked. Although he was the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, he still consulted Jiang Chen when it came to the Black Sect’s most important matter. Obviously, he considered Jiang Chen one of the key persons who could decide anything for the Black Sect.

In fact, even if Jiang Chen was appointed as Sect Chief of the Black Sect, no one would have any objections. Without Jiang Chen, there would after all be no Black Sect any longer. Furthermore, with Jiang Chen’s current strength, he could be considered the strongest man in the Qi Province.
“I have no interest in managing the sect. Sect Chief, just do what you feel is right. Once all these matters have come to an end, I’ll still have some other important matters I need to attend.”
Jiang Chen said. His words allowed Daoist Black to understand something. In the Qi Province, Daoist Black would be the only ruler. Jiang Chen had no interest in ruling the Qi Province.

During the next few days, the Black Sect was experience a real major change. Redsun Town was completely crowded, and in just three days, more than half of a brand new base had been built. For those cultivators who had amazing skills and tricks, building a new base was the simplest thing they could do.
On this day, while Jiang Chen was accompanying Yan Chenyu in her room, someone suddenly knocked on the door.
Hearing the knocking, Jiang Chen furrowed his brows. Usually, no one would come disturb him while he was accompanying Yan Chenyu. It seemed like something had happened.
Jiang Chen stood up and opened the door. It was Daoist Black who was knocking on the door.
“Sect Chief, is there anything important?”
Jiang Chen said with a displeased tone. Daoist Black better give him a good reason for disturbing him, otherwise Jiang Chen would become really angry.
“Jiang Chen, someone wants to see you.”
Daoist Black said with a solemn expression. This told Jiang Chen that the person who wanted to see him was not someone simple.
“Who?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“It is I.”
A voice came from Daoist Black’s back. After that, the man appeared in front of Jiang Chen’s eyes.
“Brother Xuan.”
Jiang Chen felt surprised. The man who was looking for him was Xuan Ye. No wonder Daoist Black became so nervous; the visit of a Combat Soul warrior had definitely shocked him.
“Brother Jiang, can I go in and have a look at my sister-in-law’s condition?”
Xuan Ye asked with a smile on his face.
“Please come in, brother Xuan.”

Jiang Chen smiled. It looked like Xuan Ye had found out about his current situation, and came here because of Yan Chenyu. But, there was no way Xuan Ye could help with Yan Chenyu’s condition. Anyhow, since he came with good intentions, Jiang Chen couldn’t just reject him.

Xuan Ye walked into the room. Daoist Black didn’t follow, he just closed the door for them. He was extremely excited right now, he had no idea who this Xuan Ye was, but he knew that this man was a powerful Combat Soul warrior, and he was Jiang Chen’s friend. If the Black Sect could have a Combat Soul warrior as a friend, it would be incredibly advantageous.
Xuan Ye walked into the room and looked at Yan Chenyu. He immediately nodded his head when he saw Yan Chenyu’s beautiful and gorgeous appearance.

“My sister-in-law is really as beautiful as a fair. Brother Jiang, Lord Jiu has learned about everything regarding you, he specifically sent me here with some herbs; we hope these can help sister-in-law.”
Xuan Yu looked at Jiang Chen and flipped his palm. A storage ring immediately appeared, “Here are some pills and herbs. Please take a look, Brother Jiang.”
Xuan Ye handed the storage ring to Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen sent his divine sense into the storage ring, and in an instant, all kinds of herbs appeared in front of Jiang Chen’s eyes.
Revival Pills, Heavenly Snow Grass, Thousand Year Old Dragon Ginseng, Bloody Fleeceflower Root

Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up. All these pills and herbs were extremely expensive, and each of them were premium quality ones that had been grown for many years. Even in the Martial Saint Dynasty, these were all top quality items amongst all precious items. There was no way he could find these in a small place like the Qi Province.

With the combination of all these herbs, they could really revive a dead man. By simply sending these precious herbs to Jiang Chen, he could easily tell how prestigious Wu Jiu’s status and background was.
But it was a pity that all these herbs were useless for Yan Chenyu. However, this actions did touch Jiang Chen’s heart.
“Brother Jiang, I think that with all these herbs, we should be able to heal sister-in-law, right?”
Xuan Ye asked with a smile. He was confident in the herbs and pills he had brought.
“Brother Xuan, all these herbs and pills are extremely priceless, please help my send my gratitude to Brother Jiu. It’s too bad, these herbs can’t help Little Yu at all.”
Jian Chen replied with a smile.
“Impossible! With the combination of all these herbs and pills, as long as the person isn’t completely dead, they will be able to heal all injuries.”
Xuan Ye was shocked. His confidence in these herbs was gigantic.
“I don’t want to hide this from Brother Xuan. Little Yu has the Nine Yin Meridians, a rare Nine Yin Body. In order to save her, I will need to find Nine Solar Holy Water.”
Jiang Chen shook his head.
“What?! Nine Yin Meridians?”
Xuan Ye exclaimed, shocked. He didn’t expect that this girl lying on the bed had such a rare and powerful body.

“The Nine Solar Holy Water is extremely rare, even Lord Jiu doesn’t have this rare item with him. According to my knowledge, none of the sects in all 28 provinces have the Nine Solar Holy Water. What should we do then?”
Xuan Ye furrowed his brows.
“None of them have it?”

Jiang Chen’s heart missed a beat. Only the Nine Solar Holy Water could heal Yan Chenyu, that’s why his next goal was to find it. Although his goal was clear, he still had no idea where to start from. When he was looking for Firethorn Savage and the Earth Devil, he still knew roughly where it could be found; there was a clear destination. However, Xuan Ye’s words just now caused him to feel like a headless fly; no idea where to go next.
“Oh right, there might be a place where you can find the Nine Solar Holy Water.”
Xuan Ye suddenly said.
“Where is that?”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
“The Blissful Villa.”
Xuan Ye said.
“Where is this Blissful Villa?”
Jiang Chen asked again

“It’s not located in any of the 28 provinces. The Blissful Villa is built on an island called the Blissful Island. There is an ocean north of the Eastern Continent, and the Blissful Island is located somewhere in that ocean. On this island, there will be a trade fair every year, and many extraordinary men, rogue cultivators, and even demon lords who live in that ocean goes there every year to participate. Also, all kinds of rare items can be found there as well. You could try your luck there. If my memory serves me well, the trade fair will start in one month. With your speed, I believe you can make it in time.”
Xuan Ye said.
“Blissful Island, Blissful Villa... Alright, I’ll make a trip to the ocean.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes were bright. Although he had no idea whether or not he could find the Nine Solar Holy Water on that Blissful Island, there was at least hope. Having a target was better that nothing.
“There are many foul demons and pirates living in the ocean. Brother Jiang, you better be careful when you’re there.”
Xuan Ye reminded.
“I don’t think the ocean will be more dangerous than Inferno Hell.”
Jiang Chen replied with a smile. He was able to walk out from a place like Inferno Hell, what was there to worry about with this Blissful Island? He had made up his man, he would go there tomorrow.
Rumble...
Right at this moment, a loud rumble could be heard outside the Black Sect’s gate. A few powerful energies carrying intense killing intent swept across the entire Black Sect.

sentences.text: “You didn’t ask me earlier either.”
Han Yan spread his arms and said in a helpless manner.
Haha...
Everyone burst into laughter.
As the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, Daoist Black had just drank a dog’s wine.
This was not something that other people should know happened.
“Damn you, what’s wrong with this master dog’s wine?
Fuck, do you all know how many people dream about having a sip of my leftover wine?
This is your lucky day, don’t try to be greedy!”
Big Yellow immediately became angry; he kept shouting at Daoist Black.
This dog didn’t care who he was facing, he would even dare challenge the father of the heavenly king.
Daoist Black stared at Big Yellow who seemed like he had just suffered the biggest grievance.
His face turned red because of embarrassment, but in the end, he just couldn’t speak any words.
If any other dog had dared be so arrogant in front of him, he would definitely have skinned the dog alive.
But, this dog was not a dog that could easily be trifled with.
Even Duan Jianhong was defeated by him.
Putting that aside, Big Yellow and Daoist Black did have a pretty good relationship.
With Daoist Black’s current condition, where he hadn’t even fully recovered, perhaps he might even be defeated by this dog.
“Sect Chief, it’s a truth that not anyone can drink Big Yellow’s wine.
Today, Brother Yan has finally recovered, and his cultivation has skyrocketed.
It’s good news for us, and we should celebrate.”
Jiang Chen hurriedly changed the focus to Han Yan, Giving Daoist Black an excuse to escape from this embarrassing moment.
“Right.
Brother Yan is considered a rare genius right now, not only does he have the Ancient Divine Devil’s bloodline, he’s even a peak Mid Divine Core warrior at such a young age.
I’m afraid even I am no match for Brother Yan.”
Daoist Black looked at Han Yan with a smile on his face.
For him, it was a glorious thing to have so many geniuses in the Black Sect.
The future would definitely shine brightly because of these geniuses.
“It’s all because of Little Chen!
Come, a toast to my Little Chen!”
Han Yan raised his wine pot and tossed off its lid.
“Damn you, shouldn’t you toast this master dog as well?
If not for this master dog, do you really think that guy could have killed the Earth Devil by himself?”
Big Yellow became furious once again.
“Brother Yan, Big Yellow did contribute to the most important part of the trip to Inferno Hell.
You should toast him as well.”
Jiang Chen said in a serious manner.
If not for Big Yellow coming along with him to Inferno Hell, Jiang Chen would not have been able to kill the Earth Devil in such a smooth manner.
Putting aside all other issues, without Big Yellow, there were two things he wouldn’t have been able to accomplish.
First, without Big Yellow, there was no way Jiang Chen could have found the hidden Blood Talisman within Inferno City.
Without the Blood Talisman, he couldn’t have handled the powerful Earth Devil.
Secondly, without Big Yellow, Jiang Chen wouldn’t have been able to leave the Poisonous Miasma Space.
The Spiraling Defense Mechanism Big Yellow mad was extraordinary, and it was the key that allowed Jiang Chen and Wu Jiu to escape from the Poisonous Miasma Space.
“Fine, a toast from me, Han Yan to Big Yellow!”
Han Yan raised the wine pot and gave Big Yellow a toast.
Only then did Big Yellow let out a satisfied laugh.
“Jiang Chen, the most important task for us now is to move the Black Sect to Redsun Town.
I have already settled everything in the Redsun Town, our next step is to start building.
Do you have any ideas how we should proceed with this?”
Daoist Black asked.
Although he was the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, he still consulted Jiang Chen when it came to the Black Sect’s most important matter.
Obviously, he considered Jiang Chen one of the key persons who could decide anything for the Black Sect.
In fact, even if Jiang Chen was appointed as Sect Chief of the Black Sect, no one would have any objections.
Without Jiang Chen, there would after all be no Black Sect any longer.
Furthermore, with Jiang Chen’s current strength, he could be considered the strongest man in the Qi Province.
“I have no interest in managing the sect.
Sect Chief, just do what you feel is right.
Once all these matters have come to an end, I’ll still have some other important matters I need to attend.”
Jiang Chen said.
His words allowed Daoist Black to understand something.
In the Qi Province, Daoist Black would be the only ruler.
Jiang Chen had no interest in ruling the Qi Province.
During the next few days, the Black Sect was experience a real major change.
Redsun Town was completely crowded, and in just three days, more than half of a brand new base had been built.
For those cultivators who had amazing skills and tricks, building a new base was the simplest thing they could do.
On this day, while Jiang Chen was accompanying Yan Chenyu in her room, someone suddenly knocked on the door.
Hearing the knocking, Jiang Chen furrowed his brows.
Usually, no one would come disturb him while he was accompanying Yan Chenyu.
It seemed like something had happened.
Jiang Chen stood up and opened the door.
It was Daoist Black who was knocking on the door.
“Sect Chief, is there anything important?”
Jiang Chen said with a displeased tone.
Daoist Black better give him a good reason for disturbing him, otherwise Jiang Chen would become really angry.
“Jiang Chen, someone wants to see you.”
Daoist Black said with a solemn expression.
This told Jiang Chen that the person who wanted to see him was not someone simple.
“Who?”
Jiang Chen asked.
“It is I.”
A voice came from Daoist Black’s back.
After that, the man appeared in front of Jiang Chen’s eyes.
“Brother Xuan.”
Jiang Chen felt surprised.
The man who was looking for him was Xuan Ye.
No wonder Daoist Black became so nervous; the visit of a Combat Soul warrior had definitely shocked him.
“Brother Jiang, can I go in and have a look at my sister-in-law’s condition?”
Xuan Ye asked with a smile on his face.
“Please come in, brother Xuan.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
It looked like Xuan Ye had found out about his current situation, and came here because of Yan Chenyu.
But, there was no way Xuan Ye could help with Yan Chenyu’s condition.
Anyhow, since he came with good intentions, Jiang Chen couldn’t just reject him.
Xuan Ye walked into the room.
Daoist Black didn’t follow, he just closed the door for them.
He was extremely excited right now, he had no idea who this Xuan Ye was, but he knew that this man was a powerful Combat Soul warrior, and he was Jiang Chen’s friend.
If the Black Sect could have a Combat Soul warrior as a friend, it would be incredibly advantageous.
Xuan Ye walked into the room and looked at Yan Chenyu.
He immediately nodded his head when he saw Yan Chenyu’s beautiful and gorgeous appearance.
“My sister-in-law is really as beautiful as a fair.
Brother Jiang, Lord Jiu has learned about everything regarding you, he specifically sent me here with some herbs; we hope these can help sister-in-law.”
Xuan Yu looked at Jiang Chen and flipped his palm.
A storage ring immediately appeared, “Here are some pills and herbs.
Please take a look, Brother Jiang.”
Xuan Ye handed the storage ring to Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen sent his divine sense into the storage ring, and in an instant, all kinds of herbs appeared in front of Jiang Chen’s eyes.
Revival Pills, Heavenly Snow Grass, Thousand Year Old Dragon Ginseng, Bloody Fleeceflower Root
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
All these pills and herbs were extremely expensive, and each of them were premium quality ones that had been grown for many years.
Even in the Martial Saint Dynasty, these were all top quality items amongst all precious items.
There was no way he could find these in a small place like the Qi Province.
With the combination of all these herbs, they could really revive a dead man.
By simply sending these precious herbs to Jiang Chen, he could easily tell how prestigious Wu Jiu’s status and background was.
But it was a pity that all these herbs were useless for Yan Chenyu.
However, this actions did touch Jiang Chen’s heart.
“Brother Jiang, I think that with all these herbs, we should be able to heal sister-in-law, right?”
Xuan Ye asked with a smile.
He was confident in the herbs and pills he had brought.
“Brother Xuan, all these herbs and pills are extremely priceless, please help my send my gratitude to Brother Jiu.
It’s too bad, these herbs can’t help Little Yu at all.”
Jian Chen replied with a smile.
“Impossible!
With the combination of all these herbs and pills, as long as the person isn’t completely dead, they will be able to heal all injuries.”
Xuan Ye was shocked.
His confidence in these herbs was gigantic.
“I don’t want to hide this from Brother Xuan.
Little Yu has the Nine Yin Meridians, a rare Nine Yin Body.
In order to save her, I will need to find Nine Solar Holy Water.”
Jiang Chen shook his head.
“What?!
Nine Yin Meridians?”
Xuan Ye exclaimed, shocked.
He didn’t expect that this girl lying on the bed had such a rare and powerful body.
“The Nine Solar Holy Water is extremely rare, even Lord Jiu doesn’t have this rare item with him.
According to my knowledge, none of the sects in all 28 provinces have the Nine Solar Holy Water.
What should we do then?”
Xuan Ye furrowed his brows.
“None of them have it?”
Jiang Chen’s heart missed a beat.
Only the Nine Solar Holy Water could heal Yan Chenyu, that’s why his next goal was to find it.
Although his goal was clear, he still had no idea where to start from.
When he was looking for Firethorn Savage and the Earth Devil, he still knew roughly where it could be found; there was a clear destination.
However, Xuan Ye’s words just now caused him to feel like a headless fly; no idea where to go next.
“Oh right, there might be a place where you can find the Nine Solar Holy Water.”
Xuan Ye suddenly said.
“Where is that?”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
“The Blissful Villa.”
Xuan Ye said.
“Where is this Blissful Villa?”
Jiang Chen asked again
“It’s not located in any of the 28 provinces.
The Blissful Villa is built on an island called the Blissful Island.
There is an ocean north of the Eastern Continent, and the Blissful Island is located somewhere in that ocean.
On this island, there will be a trade fair every year, and many extraordinary men, rogue cultivators, and even demon lords who live in that ocean goes there every year to participate.
Also, all kinds of rare items can be found there as well.
You could try your luck there.
If my memory serves me well, the trade fair will start in one month.
With your speed, I believe you can make it in time.”
Xuan Ye said.
“Blissful Island, Blissful Villa...
Alright, I’ll make a trip to the ocean.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes were bright.
Although he had no idea whether or not he could find the Nine Solar Holy Water on that Blissful Island, there was at least hope.
Having a target was better that nothing.
“There are many foul demons and pirates living in the ocean.
Brother Jiang, you better be careful when you’re there.”
Xuan Ye reminded.
“I don’t think the ocean will be more dangerous than Inferno Hell.”
Jiang Chen replied with a smile.
He was able to walk out from a place like Inferno Hell, what was there to worry about with this Blissful Island?
He had made up his man, he would go there tomorrow.
Rumble...
Right at this moment, a loud rumble could be heard outside the Black Sect’s gate.
A few powerful energies carrying intense killing intent swept across the entire Black Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - Six Heroes of Mount Mang
paragraphs: These few powerful energies carried hostile auras. They obviously came with bad intentions. This caused Jiang Chen to furrow his brows. From their auras, he could tell that they were all Late Divine Core warriors. Some of them could even compare with Daoist Black. Since Zhao Chongyang and Duan Jianhong were both dead, there were no more warriors this strong that could be found in the Qi Province, and it was impossible for so many Late Divine Core warriors to suddenly appear.
“We are the Six Heroes of Mount Mang, we’re here to kill Jiang Chen!”

A voice swept across like a sudden clap of thunder in the clear sky, and it echoed across the entire Black Mountain Range, heard by every single person. Many people had slight changes in their expressions, but at the same time, they felt that the situation was funny. This was the third time someone had come here and yelled about killing him since he first came here.
“Who are these Six Heroes of Mount Mang? When did I offend them?”
Jiang Chen was startled for a moment.
“Brother Jiang, don’t forget how many people you killed in Inferno Hell. I’m sure what you did in Inferno Hell is known by many; it’s normal that someone will come, seeking revenge.”
Xuan Ye said with a smile, as if he had expected this to happen. He had a look of leisure on his face, and it didn’t seem like he had any intentions to help.
“So you’re here to watch the show?”
Jiang Chen gazed at Xuan Ye.
“Lord Jiu told me that you need to solve your own problems. You have too many enemies, and this is just the beginning.”
Xuan Ye shrugged his shoulder, then he turned around and exited the room.
Jiang Chen gave Xuan Ye’s back his middle finger. After that, he took a step forwards and arrived outside of the gate.
Right at this moment, all great warriors of the Black Sect had arrived. They all looked at those six intrepid men.
Swoosh! Swoosh!

Han Yan and Big Yellow walked up to Jiang Chen. Han Yan threw his glance at the six men standing opposite of them, then he asked, “Little Chen, who are these Six Heroes of Mount Mang? Looks like they are pretty strong, when did you offend them?”

Six people stood opposite of them. Five men and a woman, and all of them were Late Divine Core warriors. The leading man seemed to be in his fifties, and he was at the peak of the Divine Core realm, no weaker than Daoist Black. A force like this could really go many places within the Eastern Continent without many obstacles.

These six people also had weird appearances. The woman was carrying a lute, and her hair was tied in a braid that pointing towards the sky. Jiang Chen couldn’t help but relate her to Murong Xiaorou, but this woman was much prettier than her, at least she had a curvy and seductive body. A lute was drawn onto her pretty face, which caused her to look kind of ferocious, but at the same time, giving her a touch of a wild beauty.
The rest of the men also had all kinds of weird appearances, causing people to think they were some upright men.
“Who are these people? What an unusual way to dress! They came here with such great killing intent, I wonder how senior disciple offended them.”
“Senior disciple Jiang’s ability to offend people is just like his talent, superb!”
“These few people seem really strong, but I think senior disciple Jiang should be able to handle them with ease. With his current abilities, no ordinary Late Divine Core warriors are his match.”

All the disciples of the Black Sect were discussing amongst themselves. In the past, if this strong group suddenly came to the Black Sect, they would definitely be frightened to death. But now, with the presence of Jiang Chen, they wouldn’t be scared no matter how strong the enemies were.
“Which one of you is Jiang Chen?”
The woman asked. She had a high vocal pitch that was irritating to the ear. The flute in her hand was reflecting purple ripples underneath the sunshine, it was a powerful combat weapon.
“I am. Why are you looking for me?”
Jiang Chen took a step forward.
“So it’s you who killed Mang Seven. We siblings have come here today to kill you, we will avenge our seventh brother!”
A short fat man said in an eerie manner.
“Damn you, who is that Mang Seven? Did you guys come to the wrong place?”
Big Yellow couldn’t restrain himself from speaking any longer.
“Don’t try to deny it! We were once the Seven Heroes of Mount Mang, but our seventh brother went to Inferno Hell, and according to the news we got, he was killed by you!”
Eldest Mang shouted at Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen and Big Yellow finally understood. It was because of what they had done back in Inferno Hell. They had no idea who this Mang Seven was, because they had killed too many people back in Inferno Hell. Perhaps this Mang Seven really was killed by them.

“Jiang Chen, I’ve heard about the Seven Weirdoes of Mount Mang, they are from the Qing Province, the fifth biggest province in the Eastern Continent, and they’re a group of really strong warriors. No one really dares challenge them, and they have been acting like tyrants in the Qing Province. Rumors say that this group offended a Combat Soul warrior from a big sect in the Qing Province, and out of anger, the Combat Soul warrior sent one of them to Inferno Hell by force. The remaining six weirdoes flew from the Qing Province, and were never seen again. Didn’t think I’d see them here.”
Daoist Black said. As the Black Sect’s Sect Chief, he did have some insight regarding the other provinces in the Eastern Continent.
“So you are the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang. You truly have no sense of honor, calling yourselves heroes.”
Jiang Chen said as he started laughing out loud.

“Watch your tongue! We, the Seven Weirdoes of Mount Mang... no, we, the Seven Heroes are all great warriors who surpass the ancient and dazzle the contemporaries! You’re just courting death by being impolite to us! Today, we are going to avenge seventh brother! Not only will we kill you, we’re also going to slaughter this entire sect!”
Mang Third was born with crossed eyes, and he kept blinking while he was talking, giving people an impression that there was something wrong with his mind.

When the Six Heroes of Mount Mang found out their seventh brother had been killed by Jiang Chen from the Black Sect, they immediately rushed to the Black Sect. None of them knew anything about the major change that had occurred in the Qi Province. In their minds, although Jiang Chen was strong, with their combined strength, unless it was a Combat Soul warrior who personally fought them, they wouldn’t find any match in the Divine Core realm.
“Hmph! Since you’ve done all kinds of evil things, I don’t have to be courteous to you. You would be lucky if you never had to meet me, but since you’re here, I’ll just kill you all.”
Jiang Chen coldly humphed.

“Jiang Chen, be careful when fighting them. These Six Heroes of Mount Mang are not some ordinary warriors. If you were to fight them one at a time, none of them would be your match, but once they work together, they become extremely powerful. I’ve heard they can attack flawlessly, and have the ability to attack with all kinds of skills at the same time, causing their opponent to have a hard time defending effectively. People say they’re invincible below the Combat Soul realm.”
Daoist Black reminded.
“Little Chen, shall we fight together?”
Han Yan asked with a smile.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen nodded his head. If these Six Heroes of Mount Mang really had perfect synergy, it would be pretty difficult to defeat them. After all, six Late Divine Core warriors with perfect synergy could make their combat strength increase to an incredible level. Han Yan was a peak Mid Divine Core warrior, and together with his Ancient Divine Devil bloodline, his combat strength was nearly on par with his and Big Yellow’s.
“Kaka, how could you forget Big Yellow in such an exciting moment?”
Big Yellow started laughing out loudly. His majestic body dashed forward, and he became the first one to crash into the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang.
“How come there is a dog here? It’s been a long time since Lord Fourth ate meat, and this dog looks pretty meaty. Let’s kill it and have a cooked dog meal later.”
When Mang Fourth saw Big Yellow, he became the first one to dash forward. He couldn’t help but stick out his tongue.
“How dare you want to eat this master dog?!”
Big Yellow grit his teeth in anger. His head began glowing with a golden light as he dashed toward Mang Fourth with extreme speed.
“Jiejie!”

Mang Fourth let out an evil laugh. He raised his arm, then a razor sharp dagger appeared in his hand. He waved his arm, forcefully thrusting his dagger toward Big Yellow. The other five weirdos were watching the show with joyful smiles. All of them knew how strong Mang Fourth was, and if this strike hit its target, Big Yellow’s head would definitely be destroyed.
Clang!

Too bad, a shocking scene played out in front of them. When the dagger hit Big Yellow’s head, metal clanging sound was heard, and a huge amount of sparks emerged from the center of the impact. The dog’s head wasn’t destroyed, and instead, Mang Fourth suffer a huge backlash, and his dagger nearly fell out of his hand. He was knocked back about fifty meters before he regained control of his body.
“What a tough head!”

Mang Fourth’s expression changed dramatically. He was a Late Divine Core warrior, and the dagger in his hand was a high-ranked combat weapon. But, even with the high-ranked combat weapon, he still couldn’t damage this dog’s head. This was incredibly shocking.
“Kaka, trying to fight this master dog with just that little trick, you’re too weak!”
Big Yellow laughed with his head pointed towards the skies. His majestic body was trembling because of the laughter. He was showing off his pride at the maximum level.
“Let’s fight together, this dog isn’t easy to handle.”

Eldest Mang’s expression became serious. Followed by his words, all six of them moved into different positions, and connected their auras at the same time. Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up when he saw their positions. He finally understood why the Seven Heroes of Mount Mang could run around in the Qing Province without much resistance; it was all because their synergy had reached a perfect level.
Ding...

The woman raised the lute in her hand. With a gentle swing of her soft hand, a sound-wave rushed out toward Big Yellow. Many of the disciples felt an irritating feeling when they heard the sound, as if it was some devilish tune that caused those who heard it to feel extremely uncomfortable.
“Be careful Big Yellow, this sound-wave isn’t easy to deal with!”

Han Yan reminded. Jiang Chen on the other side didn’t care at all. Attacking Big Yellow with sound waves was like trying to show off in front of an expert. Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune was much more terrifying than this devilish lute tune.

Indeed. Under the shocked gazes of the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang, Big Yellow opened his mouth widely and devoured the sound waves unleashed by the woman. After he did that, he didn’t forget to burp and say, “Doesn’t taste bad, give me some more.”
Big Yellow still had the same brimming with energy look, and he didn’t show any signs of being hurt.
“What?!”

The woman cried out in shock. She knew how powerful her devilish lute tune was. After all these years of basically running unhindered through the Qing Province, the reputation of the Lute Devil frightened many people. However, this dog in front of her had just devoured her devilish tune; this was insane!
“Die now!”

Eldest Mang immediately attacked. He was the strongest man in the group. He unleashed a huge phantom hand which slapped toward Big Yellow. At the same time, all the other weirdoes unleashed their attacks as well. It looked like they trying to kill Big Yellow with one combined attack.
“Let’s do this.”
Jiang Chen dashed forwards. On the other side, Han Yan unleashed his incredible devilish energy and unparalleled grandeur.

“How come there is a dog here?
It’s been a long time since Lord Fourth ate meat, and this dog looks pretty meaty.
Let’s kill it and have a cooked dog meal later.”
When Mang Fourth saw Big Yellow, he became the first one to dash forward.
He couldn’t help but stick out his tongue.
“How dare you want to eat this master dog?!”
Big Yellow grit his teeth in anger.
His head began glowing with a golden light as he dashed toward Mang Fourth with extreme speed.
“Jiejie!”
Mang Fourth let out an evil laugh.
He raised his arm, then a razor sharp dagger appeared in his hand.
He waved his arm, forcefully thrusting his dagger toward Big Yellow.
The other five weirdos were watching the show with joyful smiles.
All of them knew how strong Mang Fourth was, and if this strike hit its target, Big Yellow’s head would definitely be destroyed.
Clang!
Too bad, a shocking scene played out in front of them.
When the dagger hit Big Yellow’s head, metal clanging sound was heard, and a huge amount of sparks emerged from the center of the impact.
The dog’s head wasn’t destroyed, and instead, Mang Fourth suffer a huge backlash, and his dagger nearly fell out of his hand.
He was knocked back about fifty meters before he regained control of his body.
“What a tough head!”
Mang Fourth’s expression changed dramatically.
He was a Late Divine Core warrior, and the dagger in his hand was a high-ranked combat weapon.
But, even with the high-ranked combat weapon, he still couldn’t damage this dog’s head.
This was incredibly shocking.
“Kaka, trying to fight this master dog with just that little trick, you’re too weak!”
Big Yellow laughed with his head pointed towards the skies.
His majestic body was trembling because of the laughter.
He was showing off his pride at the maximum level.
“Let’s fight together, this dog isn’t easy to handle.”
Eldest Mang’s expression became serious.
Followed by his words, all six of them moved into different positions, and connected their auras at the same time.
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up when he saw their positions.
He finally understood why the Seven Heroes of Mount Mang could run around in the Qing Province without much resistance; it was all because their synergy had reached a perfect level.
Ding...
The woman raised the lute in her hand.
With a gentle swing of her soft hand, a sound-wave rushed out toward Big Yellow.
Many of the disciples felt an irritating feeling when they heard the sound, as if it was some devilish tune that caused those who heard it to feel extremely uncomfortable.
“Be careful Big Yellow, this sound-wave isn’t easy to deal with!”
Han Yan reminded.
Jiang Chen on the other side didn’t care at all.
Attacking Big Yellow with sound waves was like trying to show off in front of an expert.
Big Yellow’s Soul Crunching Tune was much more terrifying than this devilish lute tune.
Indeed.
Under the shocked gazes of the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang, Big Yellow opened his mouth widely and devoured the sound waves unleashed by the woman.
After he did that, he didn’t forget to burp and say, “Doesn’t taste bad, give me some more.”
Big Yellow still had the same brimming with energy look, and he didn’t show any signs of being hurt.
“What?!”
The woman cried out in shock.
She knew how powerful her devilish lute tune was.
After all these years of basically running unhindered through the Qing Province, the reputation of the Lute Devil frightened many people.
However, this dog in front of her had just devoured her devilish tune; this was insane!
“Die now!”
Eldest Mang immediately attacked.
He was the strongest man in the group.
He unleashed a huge phantom hand which slapped toward Big Yellow.
At the same time, all the other weirdoes unleashed their attacks as well.
It looked like they trying to kill Big Yellow with one combined attack.
“Let’s do this.”
Jiang Chen dashed forwards.
On the other side, Han Yan unleashed his incredible devilish energy and unparalleled grandeur.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - Nine Heavenly Devil Waves
paragraphs: Rumble...

Jiang Chen unleashed the True Dragon Palm and tore Eldest Mang’s attack to pieces. As for Han Yan, he unleashed a black beam looking like a devilish dragon that carried a tremendous devilish energy. It was so powerful that even the air started vibrating. With just this single attack, the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang’s formation was almost completely broken.
“Damn it, where did these abnormal monsters come from? These two brats’ cultivations are obviously weaker than ours, so how can they possess such powerful combat strength?”
Mang Fourth said in a slightly depressed manner.
“The enemies are incredible, but we still have to avenge seventh brother. Let’s attack together, kill this trio at the same time.”

Eldest Mang had a gruesome look in his eyes as he spoke. A huge silver blade appeared in his hand, and it was glowing with a deadly shine. At the same time, the other five weirdoes took out their own combat weapons. With their flawless synergy, they were able to perfectly combine their combat strength.
“Brother Yan, let’s attack with the cornering formation; we’ll use our strongest skills to break their formation.”
Jiang Chen told Han Yan. There was a light of determination in his eyes. With the combination of himself, Han Yan and Big Yellow, he was going to cripple these Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang.
“Got it.”

With a sway of his body, Han Yan moved to the back of the group. His Ancient Divine Devil bloodline had completely awakened, and with a cultivation base at the peak Mid Divine Core realm, it was a time where Han Yan felt proud of what he had. He was actually going to find someone he could test his combat strength on, and these Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang had come at the perfect time.

In the blink of an eye, Jiang Chen, Han Yan, and Big Yellow positioned themselves on three separate spots, cornering the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang in the center. It was supposed to be a scene where the six weirdoes surrounded the trio, but the tables had now turned.

But the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang had no feat at all. They had been working as a team for many years, and had gone through a lot of battles. They had now met their strongest opponent yet, and they were confident that with their flawless synergy, they would be able to defeat the trio whose cultivation was weaker than theirs.
“Let’s attack!”
Eldest Mang was the first person who attacked. With a loud voice he shouted, “Mountain Ripping Blade!”
Bang!

Eldest Mang swung the huge blade in his hand toward Jiang Chen with tremendous force. The strike carried an incredibly strong force, and it nearly sliced the space around them. A powerful buzzing sounded out, so powerful it seemed like it alone could rip a mountain to pieces.
“Rapid Thunderstorm!”
Mang Second struck at the same time with the longsword in his hand. With a swing of his sword, he unleashed countless sword lights toward Big Yellow.
“World Shaking Seal!”
“Thunderous Sword!”
“Raging Inferno, Prairie Fire!”
“Devilish Lute Tune!”
The other four weirdoes unleashed their strongest attacks at the same time. At this moment, devastating attacks and colorful energies could be seen everywhere, wreaking havoc in the entire area.

The amazing thing was, although the six of them were unleashing their own attacks, they could actually transfer their yuan energy amongst each other and completely combine the strength of all six attacks into one.

Although the strength of all their attacks was combined, they still did have their respective targets. The Mountain Ripping Blade and Devilish Lute Tune were going toward Jiang Chen. The Devilish Lute Tune was really powerful, but this woman dared not use it again Big Yellow anymore, because Big Yellow could just eat all her attacks. This frightened her. Still, she didn’t believe that Jiang Chen could also withstand here devilish tune.
The Rapid Thunderstorm sword skill and the World Shaking Seal was targeting Big Yellow, and the Thunderous Sword and Raging Inferno, Prairie Fire were crashing toward Han Yan.

“The six of them has flawless synergy, but it’s the six of them versus three opponents. It’s really difficult to have anyone under the Combat Soul realm be their match. But, with Brother Jiang and Big Yellow’s abilities, they shouldn’t have any problems handles this. What surprises me is that young man called Han Yan, he’s actually very strong as well. I didn’t expect a peerless genius like this to exist in the Black Sect.”
Xuan Ye stood far away with both arms crossed in front of his chest. There was a hint of praise in his eyes when he looked at Han Yan.
“So frightening! These six freaks are really frightening!”
“If it was a one on one fight, none of these six weirdoes would be a match for senior disciple. It’s because of their flawless synergy that their combat strength is so high.”

“Don’t worry. With the abilities of senior disciple Jiang and senior disciple Han, these six weirdoes will be defeated soon. They will see the same ending as Mang Seventh; killed by senior disciple Jiang!”

All the disciples were watching the battle in a serious manner. For them, watching a high-level battle like this was a rare opportunity. Not only would they be able to learn something from it, watching a battle like this would also help improve their cultivation.
Hmph!

Jiang Chen coldly harrumphed. With his full strength, he unleashed the True Dragon Palm. Every time he formed a new Dragon Mark, every time his cultivation progressed, the True Dragon Palm would become stronger. The gigantic blood red dragon claw grabbed the blade light unleashed by Eldest Mang, and shattered it in the most formidable way. After that, Jiang Chen unleashed the Sonic Hawk Cry. The tremendous sound-waves immediately crashing into the Devilish Lute Tune, causing a huge amount of sparks to emerge when the sound waves collided.
Clang... clang... clang...

On the other side, Big Yellow was even more formidable. He was covered in countless sword lights, but he kept pushing forward with his head, shattering all sword lights. After that, Big Yellow leapt forward like a snake, and crushed the World Shaking Seal with his head.
His hard head caused many people to feel speechless and helpless.
“Nine Heavenly Devil Waves!”

Han Yan was like a devil king as he covered himself with steaming hot devilish energies. Layers of waves pushed forwards in a seemingly invincible way, completely crushing all the opponents’ powerful attacks.
“Damn it, how can these three be so strong?! They just dismissed all our combined attacks!”
Mang Fourth kept cursing while attacking.
“Fuck his dad! My Devilish Lute Tune has never failed, not once! Whenever I used it, all enemies will be frightened to death... Why did I have to bump into two freaks today?!”

The woman carrying the flute was so mad she nearly threw up her blood. Sound-wave attacks were really difficult to defend against, and under normal conditions, no warriors would want to fight those who could attack with sound-waves, let alone sound-wave attacks unleashed through combat weapons, as the force would increase significantly.

When the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang were mentioned, everyone knew that there was a Lute Devil amongst them. But today, this woman had suffered a huge blow. Not only had she found a dog who could devour her sound waves, there was another young man who could also attack with powerful sound waves, and he even destroyed her sound wave attack.
“This Jiang Chen is much stronger than we imagined. Let’s focus our strength, don’t let the attacks be dispersed.”

Eldest Mang reminded everyone with a solemn expressed. He was starting to regret coming here without learning more about the real situation. Not only was Jiang Chen’s mightiness beyond his expectations, the other two had also made him speechless with their formidable strength.
Rumble...

The Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang repeatedly attacked, attempting to find an opportunity to kill one of their opponents. Furthermore, with Eldest Mang’s warning, all six of them became extremely careful, and dared not disperse their strength. They all knew how strong their opponents were, and once their combat strength was dispersed, they would immediately become weakened, and each of them would be killed by their opponent.

Jiang Chen, Han Yan and Big Yellow were also crazily attacking. At this moment, the entire battlefield was violently shaking. Powerful energy waves formed into countless dark clouds, while dazzling and colorful energy ripples swept across the scene.

The combat skills’ radiance was gorgeous, but behind these gorgeous radiant lights was devastating forces. If anyone jumped into the center of the battlefield, he would immediately be shattered into pieces.
“So brutal! This is the first time I’ve witnessed this kind of battle!”

“Yea! Six Late Divine Core warriors, not once in the history of the Qi Province have there been so many Late Divine Core warriors! Senior disciple Jiang Chen, senior disciple Han Yan, and Big Yellow are fighting them by themselves, and they don’t seem to be in a disadvantageous position at all!”
“It’s because those six weirdoes have flawless synergy, which gives them extremely powerful combined combat strength. Without that, none of them would be able to match senior disciples!”
“Just keep watching! Senior disciple Jiang is going to destroy their synergy sooner or later, and he will kill them all!”
Excitement filled these disciples. Witnessing a battle like this was really exciting.
“Hmph! Let’s destroy them!”

Jiang Chen coldly harrumphed. He was finally angry. He pointed his finger like a sword, then he unleashed the Six Profound Solar Fingers. In an instant, all six huge fingers merged into one bright gigantic finger. The finger destroyed all attacks coming towards him, and it kept pushing forwards.
Roar!

Big Yellow let out a roar that sounded like a dragon’s cry. A golden barrier immediately covered his body. Like a mad bull, he sprinted forward with his head in front, shattering all the powerful attack coming his way. Big Yellow who was in the center of the battlefield was not affected at all.
“Nine Heavenly Devil Waves, Seizing Life!”

Han Yan was angry as well. With his dark hair fluttering around because of his mighty devilish energy, he really looked like a mighty devil king. At this moment, he seemed like the source of all devilish energies. Waves after waves of devilish energies burst out, and each wave was stronger than the previous one. The powerful attack resembled an endless ocean’s waves as they crashed toward the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang.
Rumble...

Under these brutal attacks, the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang finally couldn’t hold on any longer. The attacks unleashed by them were all destroyed. The combined attack from Jiang Chen, Han Yan and Big Yellow was simply too formidable, and it crashed toward them in an unavoidable manner.
Bang bang bang...

With such brutal and formidable attacks, the six weirdoes’ formation was finally broken. The six weirdoes were sent flying in six different direction, and each of them had pale white faces. It looked like they had all suffered pretty bad injuries.
“Kill them.”

Jiang Chen said in a cruel manner. His eyes were even crueler than his voice. With a sway of his body, he arrived in front of the woman who carried the lute. His sudden appearance shocked the woman, and when she tried to raise her lute to fight back, Jiang Chen snatched it away with lightning speed.

Before the woman could respond, Jiang Chen took the opportunity to punch out with lightning speed. His fist landed right on the woman’s forehead, and in an instant, the woman’s skull shattered and turned into a blood mist.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - Withdrawal from the Black Sect
paragraphs: “Aiya! Senior disciple Jiang just doesn’t know that men are supposed to be tender toward woman.”
“You’re right, he is too brutal, not gentle at all.”
Many of the disciples teased Jiang Chen. But in their minds, none of them really considered this Lute Devil a woman.
“Sixth Sister!”

Eldest Mang yelled. He was so angry it seemed like a fire was going to ignite within his eyes. Without and hesitation, he shook the huge blade in his hand and drew a circle with it, then he forcefully slashed at Jiang Chen.
Hmph!

Jiang Chen coldly harrumphed, then the Bloodthirsty Sword appeared in his hand. With a swing of his arm, the Bloodthirsty Sword dashed forward like a poisonous snake and poked right into the side of the huge blade. With such tremendous force, Eldest Mang simply couldn’t hold onto the blade any longer. The huge blade was knocked away by Jiang Chen’s sword.
Puchi!
Jiang Chen was extremely fast, no one saw how he struck. In the next second, the sword impaled Eldest Mang’s chest, piercing a hole through his body.

Eldest Mang looked at the young man in front of him with extreme shock. His heart was enraged. As a peak Divine Core warrior, he had never even imagined being killed by an Early Divine Core warrior, not to mention a young one.
Eldest Mang suffered some minor injuries from the previous exchange, that’s why he was no match for Jiang Chen. Because of that, it was perfectly normal that he would be killed by Jiang Chen.

“Seven Weirdoes of Mount Mang, your evil business in the Qing Province has nothing to do with me, we walk our own separate paths. However, since your path led to you coming here to disturb me, don’t blame me for being cruel. Also, seeing how close the relationship between you seven weirdoes is, I’ll send you all to hell so you can accompany each other there.”
Jiang Chen said with a cold voice. After that, he moved his wrist and pulled his sword sideways, slicing Eldest Mang’s body in two. Just like the Lute Devil, he was killed on the spot.
Ahh!

On the other side, the formidable Big Yellow was also attacking. He had killed the cross-eyed man with his powerful head. After that, he dragged his own majestic body and slammed himself into another man.

Han Yan on the other side was also attacking in an extremely formidable manner. With the Nine Heavenly Devil Waves, he killed one of his opponents. After that, he unleashed an eerie devil claw and grabbed at the last weirdo.
Ahh! Ahh!

Finally, followed by the last two blood-curdling screeches, all Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang were dead. The trio had each killed two of them, it was a tragic ending. From now on, there wouldn’t be any legends about the Seven Weirdoes of Mount Mang in the Eastern Continent anymore.

Everyone in the Black Sect held their breath as they stared at the trio hovering in the sky with amazement in their eyes. They were extremely powerful, and none of the disciples had ever seen anyone so formidable before. The trio had just killed six Late Divine Core warriors without even giving their opponents any chance to fight back.
Xuan Ye’s eyes were glowing as well. He kept throwing examining looks on both Jiang Chen and Han Yan while nodding his head.

“Such talent, even those geniuses in the Martial Palace can’t compare with them. With Jiang Chen and Han Yan’s current cultivation levels, I think only those Late Divine Core warriors in the Martial Palace and Martial Saint Dynasty can put up a fight against them.”

Xuan Ye sighed. With his judgment, Han Yan was considered pretty standard. He was a peak Mid Divine Core warrior, and he also had a Divine Body. It was perfectly normal for him to fight and kill someone who had a higher cultivation level than himself. What really shocked Xuan Ye was actually Jiang Chen! Jiang Chen was only 17 years old, and not only was he an Early Divine Core warrior, he was also able to defeat all Divine Core warriors with his mere Early Divine Core cultivation level. Such powerful combat strength has never been seen before.

During the next days, there was not a single peaceful moment for the Black Sect. The people who wanted to kill Jiang Chen and avenge their friends kept coming. Most of them were just acting on impulse, they never fully understood the current situation, and they just kept coming with extreme anger. Of course, all of them were killed by Jiang Chen in the end. If they knew that Jiang Chen had just killed the Six Weirdoes of Mount Mang, perhaps they couldn’t be coming like they did. At least they would make some preparations.

Also, everyone from the Black Sect had finally witnessed Jiang Chen’s incredible ability in offending people. All of them were amazed by the insane amount of enemies Jiang Chen had. It had reached a level that went beyond their imagination. None of them could even begin to imagine what Jiang Chen had actually done back in Inferno Hell.

When someone was killed, there would always be someone else who comes forth to seek revenge, and when those people who came to seek revenge were killed, there would be even more people coming, to take revenge for those who failed to get revenge. All of these people were coming from all sorts of big powers from the other provinces, and all of them had respective backgrounds. If this cycle of revenge kept running, no one would be able to predict when it would come to an end.
Within the Black Sect, on Guo Shan’s mountain peak.

“Brother Jiang, it’s just the beginning, there’s simply too many powers and people who wants to kill you. The men you killed in Inferno Hell came from almost every single province in the Eastern Province, many of them were from big powers and had quite profound positions back in their respective powers. Stories of what happened in Inferno Hell must have crazily spread, and your name must have been heard by many powers and people as well. The endless waves of people seeking revenge that you had to face in the last two days is proof of that. But, I believe no more idiots will come here without preparation. They will begin to prepare before coming to kill you.”
Xuan Ye said.

“Brother Xuan, what you said is correct. I am almost in a situation where anyone could be my enemy. I don’t mind facing so many enemies, but this will definitely affect the Black Sect. The restless situation the Black Sect is facing right now is not what I want to see.”

Jiang Chen said as he furrowed his brows. The Black Sect had just unified the entire Qi Province and had just settled down. But, the Qi Province was still the same Qi Province, the Black Sect didn’t have a Combat Soul warrior that could protect them. There was no way it could compare with those bigger sects in the other provinces.

“That’s right. As long as you’re still in the Black Sect, there is no way the Black Sect won’t get affected by this. Don’t forget, amongst all your enemies, there is also the Myriad Sword Sect and Shangguan Clan from the Jian Province. Both of them are gigantic existences, and even the Martial Saint Dynasty has to show them respect to a certain degree. If a big sect like them wants to destroy the Black Sect, it would be a piece of cake.
Xuan Ye reminded.

Jiang Chen nodded his head. Although the Black Sect had become a sole power in the Qi Province, when compared to those super powers like the Shangguan Clan and the Myriad Sword Sect from the Jian Province, the gap between their power was simply too huge. There was no way they could be compared. If those two super powers really wanted to destroy the Black Sect, it would just be a matter of moving their fingers.
Finally, Jiang Chen made a decision.

“I’ll announce to the public. From today onwards, I will no longer be a part of the Black Sect, I will no longer have any relationship with the Black Sect. All hatred and desire to get revenge shall be directed toward me alone; I want to give the Black Sect peace.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes were glowing. For him, whether or not he stayed in the Black Sect made no difference. Since the situation had settled down, it was time for him to go to some bigger places. He had prepared himself, he would proceed to the Blissful Island tomorrow and participate in the trade fair. He wanted to find out where he could get the Nine Solar Holy Water. While he was away, he wanted peace for the Black Sect. After all, his friends were still here.

“If this is brother Jiang’s decision, your brother I will also provide some help for the Black Sect. I’ll make an announcement when I return; from now on, the Black Sect will be protected by the Martial Palace. Furthermore, when I leave, I will bring two persons with me, and they will continue cultivating in the Martial Palace. With this, the Martial Palace’s reason for protecting the Black Sect will become valid.”
Xuan Ye said.
Hearing this, the few other men who were also at the scene kept quiet, and their expressions changed immediately, including Daoist Black. The way they looked at Xuan Ye changed tremendously.
Oh heavens! He was from the Martial Palace!

Martial Palace! The holy land for all warriors, and it was directly controlled by the Martial Saint Dynasty. It was a place where countless geniuses dreamt about going. The Qi Province had long ago been abandoned by the Martial Saint Dynasty, so this was unexpected good news. A Combat Soul warrior from the Martial Palace would personally bring 2 of the Black Sect’s disciples with him to the Martial Palace so they could cultivate there. This was a once in a lifetime opportunity.

Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan were at the scene as well. Both of them knew Xuan Ye from back in Inferno Hell, but none of them knew he was actually from the Martial Palace. It seemed like Wu Jiu was also from the Martial Palace.

Jiang Chen was the only person who could still remain calm. He had long ago guessed that Wu Jiu was from the Martial Saint Dynasty. The reason why Xuan Ye came here to help him, even help the Black Sect, and make an exception by bringing two men back with him must have been because of Wu Jiu. He was trying to repay Jiang Chen’s help with this.
“If that’s the case, thank you, Brother Xuan.”
Jiang Chen cupped his fist toward Xuan Ye.

“Brother Jiang, you can choose two men, I’ll bring them back with me when I leave. As for you, Lord Jiu hopes you can join the Martial Palace with your own effort, and even achieve a great position in the future.”

Xuan Ye said. What Wu Jiu meant was pretty obvious, although Jiang Chen had a lot of enemies now, the Martial Palace would not protect him at all. He wanted Jiang Chen to go through everything on his own and gain more experience.

Toward Wu Jiu’s intention, Jiang Chen could only laugh. He was not the young who lacked experience that Wu Jiu thought he was, he was the reincarnated greatest Saint in the world. Of course, Wu Jiu was doing this out of good intentions, that’s why Jiang Chen didn’t say anything about it.
Jiang Chen turned to Han Yan, but before he could say anything, Han Yan hurriedly waved his hand, “Little Chen, I want to follow you, I don’t want to join the Martial Palace so quickly.”

Han Yan was also an adventurous man. Besides, Jiang Chen’s current condition was no good. He was facing a situation where almost everyone he met would be his enemy. As his brother, Han Yan wanted to fight together with him.

“Brother Yan, you better consider it twice. Entering the Martial Palace is a rare opportunity. The environment in the Martial Palace is much more suited for cultivation, the Black Sect can’t compare.”
Jiang Chen reminded again.
“That’s right. Han Yan, joining the Martial Palace is an honor, and you’ll be the pride of the Black Sect as well.”
Daoist Black hastily said.
“Don’t try to talk me into doing it, I’ve made up my mind.”
Han Yan said with determination.
After that, Jiang Chen turned to another three men; Guan Yiyun, Tian Yishan, and Yu Zihan.
“Brother Xuan, can you give me one more spot? I want to let three men join the Martial Palace.”
Jiang Chen asked.
“No problem.”
Xuan Ye agreed without hesitation.
“Senior disciple Guan, Brother Tian, Zihan, you three follow Brother Xuan and enter the Martial Palace, this is a once in a lifetime opportunity.”
Jiang Chen said to the trio. All of them had a close relationship with him, and with such a rare opportunity in front of them, Jiang Chen had to help them fight for it no matter what.

The huge blade was knocked away by Jiang Chen’s sword.
Puchi!

In the next second, the sword impaled Eldest Mang’s chest, piercing a hole through his body.

Eldest Mang suffered some minor injuries from the previous exchange, that’s why he was no match for Jiang Chen.
Because of that, it was perfectly normal that he would be killed by Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen said with a cold voice.

Just like the Lute Devil, he was killed on the spot.
Ahh!
On the other side, the formidable Big Yellow was also attacking.
He had killed the cross-eyed man with his powerful head.

Han Yan on the other side was also attacking in an extremely formidable manner.
With the Nine Heavenly Devil Waves, he killed one of his opponents.
After that, he unleashed an eerie devil claw and grabbed at the last weirdo.
Ahh!

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - Big Dog Becomes a Puppy
paragraphs: Struck by this sudden surprise, a look of excitement emerged on their faces. Entering the Martial Palace and cultivating there was a dream that existed in the minds of everyone from the younger generation, especially Tian Yishan. He had spent the last two years wandering from place to place, and not once in his wildest dreams did he imagine that he would be able to cultivate in the Martial Palace.

“Brother Xuan, you know both Guan Yiyun and Tian Yishan, they both are talented young men with great potential, and spending time cultivating them is a wise choice. Yu Zihan had absorbed a lot of energy essences from the energy vein, causing his bodies constitution to improve a lot. He is also a man with great talent, I’m sure he fits the requirement to join the Martial Palace.”
Jiang Chen told Xuan Ye.

“I’m sure the people Brother Jiang recommends are good. But, I have to remind you three, although you are considered geniuses in the Black Sect, once you arrive at the Martial Palace, you will become the most ordinary men. I’m sure you’ve heard how many amazing and promised geniuses there are in the Martial Palace. Furthermore, the competition in the Martial Palace is really intense. Therefore, don’t think you’ve gotten a sudden rise in life, it’s really the opposite. You better prepare yourselves mentally.”
Xuan Ye looked at Yu Zihan and the other two, he spoke in a serious tone.
“We’ll definitely not neglect this opportunity!”

The three of them said at the same time. The Martial Palace was a gathering place for all geniuses in the entire Eastern Continent. Those who entered the Martial Palace were all favored children of the heavens. Not only were the best geniuses from all different provinces there, there were many geniuses who came from the Martial Saint Dynasty itself. Therefore, being able to enter the Martial Palace barely meant they had stepped over a door with higher requirements. In order to get the most out of it, it all depended on their effort.

But the three of them wouldn’t give up such a rare opportunity. As Jiang Chen’s friends, they had witnessed Jiang Chen becoming stronger and stronger, and none of them wanted to fall behind too much. But since they didn’t possess an abnormal Divine Body like Han Yan did, the three of them could only do their best to cultivate in order to prove themselves.
“Listen carefully. When you three arrive at the Martial Palace, don’t bring shame to the Black Sect.”

Daoist Black once again warned the three in a serious manner. When they arrived at the Martial Palace, they would represent the Black Sect’s honor. If their performance is too lousy, the Black Sect would become a laughing stock.
On the same day, Xuan Ye left together with the three. Under the envious and jealous eyes from countless Black Sect disciples, the four of them soon disappeared.

Jiang Chen also made an announcement the same day about his withdrawal from the Black Sect. From today onwards, he was not a disciple of the Black Sect any longer, and he would leave the Qi Province and proceed to another place soon. At the same time, Jiang Chen gave out a wild statement. Those who wanted to seek revenge could just come after him, he would take them all on.
Evening. Jiang Chen walked out from Yan Chenyu’s room and threw his glance at Guo Shan who had been waiting for him.

“Older brother Guo, I have no idea how long my trip to the Blissful Island will take. It’s a long journey, and it will take me nearly two months. It’s a journey filled with danger, so I’ll need you to help me take care of Little Yu.”

Jiang Chen said in a solemn manner. He had no idea if he would find the Nine Solar Holy Water during his trip to the Blissful Island, but he could imagine how dangerous the journey would be. Not only because of the complicated situation out in the ocean, but also because of all the enemies that were seeking revenge.
What Jiang Chen worried about the most was Yan Chenyu. No matter where he went, Yan Chenyu was always attached to his heart, like a string.
“Brother, please rest assured. I, Guo Shan will protect Little Yu with my own life. As long as I can still breathe, no one is allowed to touch Little Yu!”
Guo Shan slammed his own chest and promised. His life was saved by Jiang Chen, so he had to ensure Jiang Chen that he would wouldn’t have to worry while not here.

“Good. I believe the Sect Chief will handle all matters regarding the Black Sect. The construction of the new home base in Redsun Town has almost come to an end, all of you will be able to move there in just a few days. Brother Yan and I will leave for the Blissful Island tonight.”

Jiang Chen patted Guo Shan’s shoulder. Since Fan Zhongtang was dead, and the Qi Province had been unified, as well as the Martial Palace’s protection, Jiang Chen actually didn’t have many worries regarding Yan Chenyu’s safety.
In the same night, Jiang Chen left the Black Sect together with Han Yan and Big Yellow, then he began his journey toward the vast ocean.

“In order to cross the Eastern Continent and reach the ocean, with our current speed, it will take us at least twenty days. Once we’ve reached the ocean, it’ll take us a few more days to reach the Blissful Island. Looks like we have to fully utilize our time and rush, if not, we might miss the trade fair.”
Jiang Chen said.

“Little Chen, that is the best possible result, but we have to cross several provinces in order to reach the ocean, and with our combination, I’m afraid we might bump into a lot of trouble along our journey.”
Han Yan said.

“You’re right. There are people who wants to kill me everywhere. If we bump into any of them, our journey will definitely be delayed. If we’re unfortunate enough to bump into some Combat Soul warriors, it would be even worse.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head. He agreed with what Han Yan said.
“What is there to worry about? Those enemies only know Jiang Chen’s name, they don’t know what you look like. They wouldn’t be able to recognize you even if you stood right in front of them.”
Big Yellow said. His tail was wagging back and forth.
“Indeed, they can’t recognize me. But if you follow me, I’m sure they’ll figure out who I am.”

Jiang Chen said as he stared at Big Yellow. There were many young geniuses like him in the Eastern Continent, but only he had a dog that followed him everywhere he went. Furthermore, Big Yellow’s appearance made it extremely easy for him to be recognized. As long as they saw Big Yellow, even an idiot would know that the young man next to him was Jiang Chen.
“Damn it, what do you mean, buddy? Don’t tell me you’re going to dumb daddy behind? Without daddy following you, will you able to sense those precious treasures?”
Big Yellow instantly became angry.
“Why are you getting so upset? I never said I was going to dump you behind.”

Jiang Chen glared at Big Yellow. Even if Big Yellow wanted to leave him, Jiang Chen would drag him back with all his effort. Although Jiang Chen could recognize any ordinary treasures with his experience, Big Yellow was the one who had the ability to sense all precious treasures. There would definitely be a lot of rare treasures in the trade fair, and with this dog following along, they might be able to find a great fortune.
“What Little Chen means is that you need to disguise yourself.”
Han Yan said with a laugh.
“Damn it, why me?”
Big Yellow widened his eyes.
“Because you are easily recognizable.”
Jiang Chen shrugged his shoulders.
“Fuck! How do you want this master dog to disguise himself?”
Looking at how Jiang Chen and Han Yan were acting, Big Yellow knew he couldn’t escape from disguising himself.
“It depends on you. As long as you can disguise yourself into something so that no one can realize you’re a dog.”
Han Yan said, laughing.
“Damn you! Han Yan, you’re the dog, you entire family are all dogs!”
Big Yellow gnashed his teeth in anger. He threw his glance onto Han Yan’s butt.
“Fuck! It’s you who keeps say you’re a master dog, alright? Also, look at yourself in a mirror and see if you really are a dog or not!”
Han Yan nearly coughed up some blood. This dog was ridiculous, he kept addressing himself as the master dog, but he just denied being a dog.
“No way! There is no way I can change my handsome and mighty image!”
Big Yellow firmly shook his head.
“If you refuse to disguise yourself, even if we arrived at the Blissful Island, I don’t think we will have time for the trade fair, as we’ll spend all our time running around for our lives.”

Jiang Chen said in a serious manner. The Blissful Island’s trade fair was a famous even, many big sects would send their warriors to participate. Once Jiang Chen was recognized by any one of them, it would become a terrible event.
“Big Yellow, with your amazing abilities, transforming yourself into a small form should be a piece of cake, right?”
Han Yan looked at Big Yellow.
What? Transforming into a smaller form? Big Yellow was startled.
“Han Yan, daddy is such a handsome and mighty existence, and you ask daddy to transform my majestic body into a puppy? This is an insult to this master dog!”
Big Yellow gnashed his teeth in anger. It seemed like he was about to jump up and bite Han Yan’s butt.

“Big Yellow, Han Yan’s idea isn’t bad. Transforming into a puppy, your iconic image won’t be so obvious. If we asked you to transform into a pig, or even a mouse, that would seriously affect you mighty and handsome imagine.”
Jiang Chen said.
“No way! Daddy isn’t going to do it no matter what!”
Big Yellow started jumping. He would never do something that would cause damage to his image, he just couldn’t accept transforming into a puppy.
But too bad, Big Yellow was a mighty Divine Beast, it was extremely difficult for him to transform into human shape. With his current cultivation, he had no way of doing it.
“Big Yellow, why don’t you try transforming into a smaller form? Perhaps you’ll look even more mighty then!”
Han Yan pursued. He knew Big Yellow’s real identity, so he knew that Big Yellow had the ability to transform himself into a smaller form.
“No way!”
Big Yellow’s attitude was firm.
“Damn you! Brother Yan, let’s go, we’ll part with this dog now.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow. Then, he just turned around and flew away. Han Yan immediately followed after. They really dumped Big Yellow behind.
“Fuck you! You bastards, without this master dog, do you really think you can find precious treasures?!”
Big Yellow yelled. Jiang Chen and Han Yan ignored him, and just continued flying.
“Damn it! These bastards! Alright, this master dog will transform!”
Big Yellow finally gave in. Just after his words left his mouth, Jiang Chen and Han Yan returned to him fast as lightning. Huge grins could be found on their faces.
Big Yellow kept gnashing his teeth and murmuring to himself. His body start glowing with a golden light, and while glowing, his majestic body started shrinking.

In just the blink of an eye, the majestic Big Yellow transformed into a half meter long puppy. A pair of cute eyes were angrily staring at Jiang Chen and Han Yan, but his current appearance was absolutely adorable.
Pfff~ Hahaha...

Jiang Chen and Han Yan couldn’t hold it any longer. Both of them instantly burst out into laughter. Their bodies were bending back and forth as they laugh, and they started feeling pain in their stomachs from laughing too much. The ferocious Big Yellow had actually transformed into an adorable puppy. This puppy in front of them looked like a big kitty, and no signs of ferociousness could be found. Even when angry he looked absolutely adorable.
If they hadn’t just witnessed him transform, even Jiang Chen wouldn’t have been able to recognize Big Yellow.
