When they arrived at the Martial Palace, they would represent the Black Sect’s honor.
If their performance is too lousy, the Black Sect would become a laughing stock.
On the same day, Xuan Ye left together with the three.
Under the envious and jealous eyes from countless Black Sect disciples, the four of them soon disappeared.
Jiang Chen also made an announcement the same day about his withdrawal from the Black Sect.
From today onwards, he was not a disciple of the Black Sect any longer, and he would leave the Qi Province and proceed to another place soon.
At the same time, Jiang Chen gave out a wild statement.
Those who wanted to seek revenge could just come after him, he would take them all on.
Evening.
Jiang Chen walked out from Yan Chenyu’s room and threw his glance at Guo Shan who had been waiting for him.
“Older brother Guo, I have no idea how long my trip to the Blissful Island will take.
It’s a long journey, and it will take me nearly two months.
It’s a journey filled with danger, so I’ll need you to help me take care of Little Yu.”
Jiang Chen said in a solemn manner.
He had no idea if he would find the Nine Solar Holy Water during his trip to the Blissful Island, but he could imagine how dangerous the journey would be.
Not only because of the complicated situation out in the ocean, but also because of all the enemies that were seeking revenge.
What Jiang Chen worried about the most was Yan Chenyu.
No matter where he went, Yan Chenyu was always attached to his heart, like a string.
“Brother, please rest assured.
I, Guo Shan will protect Little Yu with my own life.
As long as I can still breathe, no one is allowed to touch Little Yu!”
Guo Shan slammed his own chest and promised.
His life was saved by Jiang Chen, so he had to ensure Jiang Chen that he would wouldn’t have to worry while not here.
“Good.
I believe the Sect Chief will handle all matters regarding the Black Sect.
The construction of the new home base in Redsun Town has almost come to an end, all of you will be able to move there in just a few days.
Brother Yan and I will leave for the Blissful Island tonight.”
Jiang Chen patted Guo Shan’s shoulder.
Since Fan Zhongtang was dead, and the Qi Province had been unified, as well as the Martial Palace’s protection, Jiang Chen actually didn’t have many worries regarding Yan Chenyu’s safety.
In the same night, Jiang Chen left the Black Sect together with Han Yan and Big Yellow, then he began his journey toward the vast ocean.
“In order to cross the Eastern Continent and reach the ocean, with our current speed, it will take us at least twenty days.
Once we’ve reached the ocean, it’ll take us a few more days to reach the Blissful Island.
Looks like we have to fully utilize our time and rush, if not, we might miss the trade fair.”
Jiang Chen said.

“Little Chen, that is the best possible result, but we have to cross several provinces in order to reach the ocean, and with our combination, I’m afraid we might bump into a lot of trouble along our journey.”
Han Yan said.
“You’re right.
There are people who wants to kill me everywhere.
If we bump into any of them, our journey will definitely be delayed.
If we’re unfortunate enough to bump into some Combat Soul warriors, it would be even worse.”
Jiang Chen nodded his head.
He agreed with what Han Yan said.
“What is there to worry about?
Those enemies only know Jiang Chen’s name, they don’t know what you look like.
They wouldn’t be able to recognize you even if you stood right in front of them.”
Big Yellow said.
His tail was wagging back and forth.
“Indeed, they can’t recognize me.
But if you follow me, I’m sure they’ll figure out who I am.”
Jiang Chen said as he stared at Big Yellow.
There were many young geniuses like him in the Eastern Continent, but only he had a dog that followed him everywhere he went.
Furthermore, Big Yellow’s appearance made it extremely easy for him to be recognized.
As long as they saw Big Yellow, even an idiot would know that the young man next to him was Jiang Chen.
“Damn it, what do you mean, buddy?
Don’t tell me you’re going to dumb daddy behind?
Without daddy following you, will you able to sense those precious treasures?”
Big Yellow instantly became angry.
“Why are you getting so upset?
I never said I was going to dump you behind.”
Jiang Chen glared at Big Yellow.
Even if Big Yellow wanted to leave him, Jiang Chen would drag him back with all his effort.
Although Jiang Chen could recognize any ordinary treasures with his experience, Big Yellow was the one who had the ability to sense all precious treasures.
There would definitely be a lot of rare treasures in the trade fair, and with this dog following along, they might be able to find a great fortune.
“What Little Chen means is that you need to disguise yourself.”
Han Yan said with a laugh.
“Damn it, why me?”
Big Yellow widened his eyes.
“Because you are easily recognizable.”
Jiang Chen shrugged his shoulders.
“Fuck!
How do you want this master dog to disguise himself?”
Looking at how Jiang Chen and Han Yan were acting, Big Yellow knew he couldn’t escape from disguising himself.
“It depends on you.
As long as you can disguise yourself into something so that no one can realize you’re a dog.”
Han Yan said, laughing.
“Damn you!
Han Yan, you’re the dog, you entire family are all dogs!”
Big Yellow gnashed his teeth in anger.
He threw his glance onto Han Yan’s butt.
“Fuck!
It’s you who keeps say you’re a master dog, alright?
Also, look at yourself in a mirror and see if you really are a dog or not!”
Han Yan nearly coughed up some blood.
This dog was ridiculous, he kept addressing himself as the master dog, but he just denied being a dog.
“No way!
There is no way I can change my handsome and mighty image!”
Big Yellow firmly shook his head.
“If you refuse to disguise yourself, even if we arrived at the Blissful Island, I don’t think we will have time for the trade fair, as we’ll spend all our time running around for our lives.”
Jiang Chen said in a serious manner.
The Blissful Island’s trade fair was a famous even, many big sects would send their warriors to participate.
Once Jiang Chen was recognized by any one of them, it would become a terrible event.
“Big Yellow, with your amazing abilities, transforming yourself into a small form should be a piece of cake, right?”
Han Yan looked at Big Yellow.
What?
Transforming into a smaller form?
Big Yellow was startled.
“Han Yan, daddy is such a handsome and mighty existence, and you ask daddy to transform my majestic body into a puppy?
This is an insult to this master dog!”
Big Yellow gnashed his teeth in anger.
It seemed like he was about to jump up and bite Han Yan’s butt.
“Big Yellow, Han Yan’s idea isn’t bad.
Transforming into a puppy, your iconic image won’t be so obvious.
If we asked you to transform into a pig, or even a mouse, that would seriously affect you mighty and handsome imagine.”
Jiang Chen said.
“No way!
Daddy isn’t going to do it no matter what!”
Big Yellow started jumping.
He would never do something that would cause damage to his image, he just couldn’t accept transforming into a puppy.
But too bad, Big Yellow was a mighty Divine Beast, it was extremely difficult for him to transform into human shape.
With his current cultivation, he had no way of doing it.
“Big Yellow, why don’t you try transforming into a smaller form?
Perhaps you’ll look even more mighty then!”
Han Yan pursued.
He knew Big Yellow’s real identity, so he knew that Big Yellow had the ability to transform himself into a smaller form.
“No way!”
Big Yellow’s attitude was firm.
“Damn you!
Brother Yan, let’s go, we’ll part with this dog now.”
Jiang Chen gazed at Big Yellow.
Then, he just turned around and flew away.
Han Yan immediately followed after.
They really dumped Big Yellow behind.
“Fuck you!
You bastards, without this master dog, do you really think you can find precious treasures?!”
Big Yellow yelled.
Jiang Chen and Han Yan ignored him, and just continued flying.
“Damn it!
These bastards!
Alright, this master dog will transform!”
Big Yellow finally gave in.
Just after his words left his mouth, Jiang Chen and Han Yan returned to him fast as lightning.
Huge grins could be found on their faces.
Big Yellow kept gnashing his teeth and murmuring to himself.
His body start glowing with a golden light, and while glowing, his majestic body started shrinking.
In just the blink of an eye, the majestic Big Yellow transformed into a half meter long puppy.
A pair of cute eyes were angrily staring at Jiang Chen and Han Yan, but his current appearance was absolutely adorable.
Pfff~ Hahaha...
Jiang Chen and Han Yan couldn’t hold it any longer.
Both of them instantly burst out into laughter.
Their bodies were bending back and forth as they laugh, and they started feeling pain in their stomachs from laughing too much.
The ferocious Big Yellow had actually transformed into an adorable puppy.
This puppy in front of them looked like a big kitty, and no signs of ferociousness could be found.
Even when angry he looked absolutely adorable.
If they hadn’t just witnessed him transform, even Jiang Chen wouldn’t have been able to recognize Big Yellow.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - Lucky Strike
paragraphs: “Damn you! Are you two done laughing?”
Big Yellow kept looking at them with eyes that felt like devouring the two laughing men. He felt that his current image was a really huge insult to his mighty and supreme image.
“Not yet, just let me laugh some more!”
Han Yan was convulsed with laughter, and he didn’t show any signs of stopping. Soon after, a shrill scream burst out from his mouth.
“Ouch! My butt!”
A terrible pain came from Han Yan’s butt. Big Yellow was too fast, so fast that Han Yan didn’t even notice having been bitten on his butt.
“Damn dog, let go of me, the pain is killing daddy!”
Han Yan cursed. He turned around and slapped Big Yellow’s head, but not only did he not knock Big Yellow away, he even hurt his palm because of the backlash.
“Damn it, what is this dog’s head made off?! Why is it so tough!? Ouch! Loosen your mouth, daddy’s butt is going to explode!”
Han Yan’s face was twisting in pain, but Big Yellow didn’t want to release the butt. Next, a violent fight erupted between the man and dog.

Looking at what was happening, Jiang Chen covered his eyes with his hand, praying for Han Yan in his mind. This man and dog made him think about what happened when he first met Big Yellow. Jiang Chen knew better than anyone else how strong this dog was.
“Fuck! Damn dog, if you don’t release me, I’m going to fart!”
Han Yan roared out loudly. This trick did work. Hearing that Han Yan was going to fart, Big Yellow immediately let go of his butt and dashed aside. Then, he transformed back into his original form.
“How dare you bite daddy’s butt?!”

Han Yan was furious. He immediately dashed toward Big Yellow. On the other side, Big Yellow was also still angry. It looked like he was going to take a few more bites before he could calm down. He just couldn’t bear the fact that they asked him to transform from a mighty doing into a puppy.
Bang, bang, bang...
Another fight erupted. The man and dog were fighting in the wilderness, and it was hard to tell which one was winning. Jiang Chen just stood aside, watching the show with a smile on his face.

The man and dog fought for nearly ten minutes. In the end, neither could defeat the other, and both of them looked miserable. Han Yan’s clothes were falling apart because of Big Yellow’s teeth, and Big Yellow’s golden fur no longer had the same luster, causing him to look like a stray dog.
“That’s enough, I think both of you have fought enough for now. It’s time to go.”
Jiang Chen said as he shrugged his shoulders.
“Little Chen, you just stood aside and watched us like you were watching a monkey show, is this really fine?”
Han Yan was speechless.
“Neither of you are good men!”

Big Yellow threw his gaze at both Jiang Chen and Han Yan. When he thought of the fact that he had to hide his mighty and handsome image in the future, and disguise himself as a puppy in public, the fury in his heard started burning more intensely.

“I was thinking, even if you can become smaller, you still look like a dog. Why don’t we use a towel to cover Big Yellow’s head, and only show his eyes? I can guarantee no one will be able to tell who he is!”
Han Yan suggested.
“Fuck!”
Big Yellow opened his mouth and bitt toward Han Yan’s butt again.
“Damn you, again?!”
Han Yan instantly moved, he turned into a trail of light and flew forward. He didn’t want to bother with this dog anymore; he had finally witnessed and experienced how stubborn this dog was.
Haha...
Jiang Chen burst into laughter and caught up to both of them. It wasn’t hard to imagine, with these two as his companions, his future journey wouldn’t be lonely and boring.
A few days later, the trio arrived in the Qing Province.
“I think we’ve just arrived in the Qing Province. We are pretty fast, we should be able to arrive before the trade fair begins.”
Jiang Chen said.

“The Qing Province is the fifth largest province in the Qi Province, really outstanding! Just the landscape and energy alone is not something the Qi Province can compare with. The natural Yuan energy here is much stronger than in the Qi Province, no wonder why it’s ranked fifth in the Eastern Continent. All the sects here are considered super powers in the eyes of the Black Sect.”
Han Yan said with mixed emotions.
“Let’s go. We’ll cross the Qing Province immediately, and try our best not to get into any trouble.”
Jiang Chen said. He then turned around and looked at Big Yellow who followed behind him, or to be exact, a golden puppy.
“Big Yellow, why haven’t you said a word along the way?”
Jiang Chen teased.
“Get lost!”

Big Yellow had been feeling depressed along the way, he really disliked his current imagine. If not for the fact that if he transformed, he would be discovered by enemies, he would have long ago transformed back into his original look.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan exchanged a glance and smiled together. They knew Big Yellow was in a bad mood right now, so they didn’t want to provoke him anymore. Soon, they resumed their journey and flew toward the inner territory of the Qing Province.
Jiang Chen didn’t waste his time on the road, he absorbed a lot of demon souls, and in just a few days, he had formed another hundred Dragon Marks, allowing his cultivation to progress once again.

“Little Chen, the skill you’re cultivating is really terrifying, it can directly absorb any souls. In just a few days, I can feel that your aura has become stronger. You’re getting closer to breaking through to the Mid Divine Core realm.”
Han Yan looked at Jiang Chen with a surprised expression.

“Yes, the method I use to level up is really incredible, but I can’t keep using this method, as it will seriously affect my foundation. I still have quite a number of souls that I can absorb, but with my current condition, I can’t absorb them anymore. If I do, my foundation will be seriously affected, and the loss will outweigh the gain.”

Jiang Chen explained to Han Yan. After that, knowingly or unknowingly, he gazed at Big Yellow. Jiang Chen had reached a bottleneck in his Dragon Transformation skill’s cultivation. If he wanted to improve his foundation, the best solution was to make the Dragon Transformation skill evolve again.

If he could get more of Big Yellow’s blood, he would be able to make the Dragon Transformation skill evolve again. However, Jiang Chen could only put this thought in his mind. Looking at Big Yellow’s gloomy face, if he dared mention this request, Big Yellow would certainly go on a rampage.

More importantly, there would be a serious side effect to Big Yellow if he took away his blood. Jiang Chen didn’t want to hurt his own brother just to make himself stronger. In his heart, both Big Yellow and Han Yan were his brothers that he would give his life for.

Furthermore, each time Jiang Chen’s cultivation advanced, his demand would become greater. Even though Big Yellow had the Dragon Horse’s bloodline, only the blood essence from his source was useful for Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen just couldn’t bring himself to draw out Big Yellow’s blood essence.

Right at this moment, a wild breeze blew by. A nearly 30 meter tall eagle suddenly swooped in from their left. A couple of young men stood on the back of this huge eagle, all of them wore arrogant expressions on their faces. Their cultivation bases were pretty strong, none of them were below the Divine Core realm. It was impossible to find such a group of young strong men in the Qi Province.
“You men in front of us, move aside quickly if you don’t want to get killed!”
A young man dressed in green clothes shouted at Jiang Chen’s group. He was carrying a whip in his hand, and it seemed like if Jiang Chen didn’t move aside, he would attack them with his whip.
“Fuck, so arrogant!”

Han Yan was very angry, but he was immediately stopped by Jiang Chen. These few young men all wore the same clothes, and it wasn’t hard to see that they were some genius disciples from a big sect in the Qing Province. They were all prideful, and they had no respect for anyone. Jiang Chen just wanted to proceed to the Blissful Island, he wanted no trouble in the Qing Province.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan moved aside, making way for these people. When the arrogant group came closer, they purposely slowed down and gazed at Jiang Chen and Han with looks carrying despise. When the arrogant young man who just shouted saw Big Yellow, he immediately burst out into laughter.
“Haha, look, this guy got a puppy as his pet beast! Truly a garbage man!”
The young man was cheerfully laughing.
“What are you looking at? Stupid bitch!”
Big Yellow cursed. Fury was still burning within his stomach, there was no way he would be courteous with these guys.
“Damn dog, what did you just say?”
The young man was immediately pissed off.
“I said you’re a stupid bitch! All of you are stupid bitches! All your family members are stupid bitches!”
Big Yellow said with disdain.
“Fuck you! You’re courting death!”
The young was extremely furious. He immediately whipped at Big Yellow. The whip was like a poisonous snake as it whipped toward Big Yellow, and it produced a large amount of sparks along its way.
Pa!
A big hand grabbed the whip. With a cold tone, Jiang Chen said, “Friends, you better not challenge us.”
“Who are you?! How dare you talk to me like that?! You’re courting death!”

The young man was really arrogant and aggressive. He was so prideful that he would look down on anyone. Just as he was about to strike once again, a female disciple with seductive makeup stopped him and said, “Let it, junior disciple Wang. Don’t delay senior disciple Mao’s important matters. Senior disciple Mao has gone ahead of us, and I think he should have arrived at the Serpent River by now. That serpent is going to transform into a Flood Dragon today, and senior disciple Mao is going to kill it during its weakened period, we have to rush over and help.”
“Hmph! Consider this your lucky day!”
The young man coldly harrumphed. He immediately pulled the whip out from Jiang Chen’s hand. Then, they continued their journey on the eagle’s back.
“Damn it! Just look at his idiot look, who gave him the audacity to be so arrogant in front of this master dog? Little Chen, why did you stop me? This master dog wants to bite them to death!”
Big Yellow was flustered and exasperated.
“Hey guys, did you heard what they said just now? They’re heading to the Serpent River.”
Jiang Chen’s eyes lit up.
“I heard some of what that girl said. There’s a strong giant serpent that’s going to evolve into a Flood Dragon in the Serpent River.”
Han Yan said.

“That’s right. Although a serpent is pretty strong, it’s still just a serpent, still considered the same as a snake or python. It’s extremely difficult for one to evolve into a dragon. There shouldn’t be any powerful giant serpents in the Qing Province, so if my prediction is correct, it should be a peak Divine Core giant serpent that is evolving toward the Combat Soul realm. But, because of its bloodline, this giant serpent is going to evolve in advance in order to completely become a Flood Dragon.”

Jiang Chen explained to the group. Just as he finished speaking, a loud bang could be heard from afar. Somewhere far from where they were right now, lightning accompanied by the peals of thunder could be seen, even from far away.

“That’s the Heavenly Tribulation! A serpent evolving into a flood dragon is an act of defiance against the natural order, and that giant serpent just attracted the rare Heavenly Tribulation. Although the strength of this tribulation isn’t strong, it’s not something a peak Divine Core demon lord can withstand. Even if this giant serpent manages to succeed, it will enter the weakest period of its life. Those people just now were actually going after this giant serpent who is evolving into a Flood Dragon! Hahaha! Looks like I was struck by a lucky strike!”
Jiang Chen burst into laughter. With a sway of his body, he immediately started flying forward, following those people he encountered not long ago.

There shouldn’t be any powerful giant serpents in the Qing Province, so if my prediction is correct, it should be a peak Divine Core giant serpent that is evolving toward the Combat Soul realm.
But, because of its bloodline, this giant serpent is going to evolve in advance in order to completely become a Flood Dragon.”
Jiang Chen explained to the group.
Just as he finished speaking, a loud bang could be heard from afar.
Somewhere far from where they were right now, lightning accompanied by the peals of thunder could be seen, even from far away.
“That’s the Heavenly Tribulation!
A serpent evolving into a flood dragon is an act of defiance against the natural order, and that giant serpent just attracted the rare Heavenly Tribulation.
Although the strength of this tribulation isn’t strong, it’s not something a peak Divine Core demon lord can withstand.
Even if this giant serpent manages to succeed, it will enter the weakest period of its life.
Those people just now were actually going after this giant serpent who is evolving into a Flood Dragon!
Hahaha!
Looks like I was struck by a lucky strike!”
Jiang Chen burst into laughter.
With a sway of his body, he immediately started flying forward, following those people he encountered not long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - Minor Three Tribulation
paragraphs: Layers of dark clouds descended from the skies and condensed themselves far above in the skies. This Heavenly Tribulation didn’t seem to be aggressive, it obviously wasn’t a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation. Also, it occurred at a remote and deserted place. If not, it would definitely have attracted the attention of a lot of people.
“Daddy hasn’t seen what a Heavenly Tribulation looks like. My knowledge of this world will increase today.”
Han Yan spoke with a shocked expression as he followed Jiang Chen.
“Country bumpkin.”
Big Yellow threw his gaze at Han Yan.
“Fuck, have you seen any Heavenly Tribulations before this?”
Han Yan looked at Big Yellow and asked.
“Never.”
Big Yellow turned his head away.
Ugh...
Han Yan became speechless.

“However, I do know that a Heavenly Tribulation won’t easily appear. When something is going to defy the natural order and isn’t accept by the heavens, at that point of time, the Heavenly Tribulation will appear as punishment and destroy that thing.”
Big Yellow said.
“What are the things that can be considered to defy the natural order?”
Han Yan curiously asked.

“You really are a country bumpkin. Things that defies the natural order isn’t known. For example, the Saint Origin realm is an independent realm, and anything that has strength greater than what this realm can contain will be considered something that defies the natural order, and it will not be accepted by this realm. Therefore, a Heavenly Tribulation will appear to eliminate them. The serpent belongs to the snake category, and it’s now going to evolve into a more advanced life form. Although it’s just going to transform into a Flood Dragon, and not a True Dragon, its bloodline will still experience a tremendous evolution, and it will become a noble existence. That’s the reason why a Heavenly Tribulation has appeared, its purpose is to punish this serpent. If this serpent can withstand the punishment, it will transform into a dragon and become a noble existence. If it can’t survive the tribulation, it will turn into ashes and die on the spot.”
Big Yellow Dog explained.

“What Big Yellow said is correct. It’s the same for humans. When we break through to the Saint realm, we have to withstand the punishment of the heavens. If we can survive it, we’ll successfully break through to the Saint Realm. If we don’t, we will perish and turn into ash. Cruelty is nature of cultivation.”

Jiang Chen said. In his previous life, he had gone through two Heavenly Tribulations. The first appeared when he was breaking through to the Minor Saint realm, and the second when he broke through to the Great Saint realm. Therefore, he knew very well how terrifying it was. Compared to what he had gone through, the tribulation the giant serpent was facing right now was nothing. The only regret Jiang Chen had was not being able to go through the Immortal Tribulation. If he did, he would be able to evolve into an immortal, and break through into the Immortal Realm.
“A Saint’s tribulation, I wonder what that will look like...”

Han Yan said with mixed emotions. For him, a Saint was someone supreme that he couldn’t even imagine. In the Eastern Continent, even a Combat King warrior was a rare existence, let alone the even more powerful Saint. Han Yan was born in the small Qi Province, and although he had great talent and was a peak Mid Divine Core warrior, in his mind, the Saint realm was still just a legend in his eyes.

“Little Chen is a man who defies the natural order, I can guarantee that when he starts forming his Combat Soul, the Heavenly Tribulation will be attracted. If you don’t believe me, just wait and see.”

Big Yellow was an excellent judge of character, he always had accurate judgment of people. With Jiang Chen’s degree of defiance towards the natural order, this realm would soon lose its tolerance, and the moment Jiang Chen breaks through to the Combat Soul realm, he would being going through endless Heavenly Tribulations.
“You’re right. Little Chen is just an abnormal monster. He’s only an Early Divine Core warrior, but I can’t think of anyone in the same stage as him who can be so strong.”
Han Yan nodded his head. He had no doubts about what Big Yellow said. Jiang Chen’s insanely abnormal strength was obvious.
A smile appeared on Jiang Chen’s face, and his eyes became brighter. He had no fear toward the Heavenly Tribulation. In this life, he was going to walk a path that defied the heavenly order.
Rumble...

The thunder was furiously roaring in the skies. Rainbow colored lightning started appearing in the dark clouds. The lightning swiftly jumped around in the skies like snakes. Although the scene looked beautiful, the energy contained within these clouds were beyond anyone’s imagination.
Flying at their top speed, the trio soon approached the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream. Being so close, the pressure from the Heavenly Tribulation clouds could make one’s soul tremble.

Seven people were standing right in front of them. All of them looked to be young, and they wore the same green clothes. Solemn expressions could be found on their faces, and they were all staring into the direction pointing towards the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream. Jiang Chen had previously met six of them, and the eagle those six rode was nowhere to be seen. In front of their group, a man firmly stood.

This man had a handsome face, and fair skin complexion. His body was full of power and grandeur, and his brows were aggressively curved. The aura of a great warrior could be sensed from his entire body.

The man seemed like he was in his mid-twenties, but his cultivation base was extremely strong, it was at the Late Divine Core realm. Having such an incredible cultivation base at his age proved that this man had extraordinary talent.
“Hey, those two guys followed us here.”
When the young man who had a conflict with Jiang Chen just now saw them, his expression instantly became cold.
“What are you looking at? Stupid bitch!”
Big Yellow was squatting down on Jiang Chen’s shoulder. He was baring his teeth while letting out some provoking words.
“Fuck you!”

The young man couldn’t hold his anger any longer. He was a respected man with his status back in his sect, but this dog kept provoking him and cursing him as a stupid bitch. He just couldn’t stand it any longer.
“What’s wrong?”
The leading man threw his gaze at Jiang Chen and Han Yan while furrowing his brows. A look of hostility could be found in his eyes.
“Senior disciple Mao, I don’t know where these two guys came from. They had a conflict with junior disciple Wang just now, and that puppy is abominable, it has a disgusting mouth!”
A female disciple said. From the way she talked, one could easily tell how must respect and admiration she had toward this senior disciple Mao.
“Hmph! Kill them all.”
The senior disciple Mao coldly harrumphed as he prepared to attack Jiang Chen.
Roar!

Right at this moment, a roar so powerful the ground started shaking sounded out from the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream. After that, a thirty meter long silver-white giant serpent flew out from the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream. It flew into the sky and coiled its body underneath the dark clouds.

This giant serpent had a huge body. Scales the size of a human’s palm fully covered its body. On both sides of its body, two huge claws could be seen emitting a metal radiance. On top of its head there were two long silver white horns that shone brightly. It had a ferocious look in its eyes, causing those who stared into them to feel as if they had been dragged into hell.
“Look, senior disciple Mao, that giant serpent has come out to meet its Heavenly Tribulation!”
That female disciple shouted out with great fear.
“Hmph! Let’s leave those two guys alone for now. They better not cause any trouble for me! If they do, I’ll make sure they die in the most miserable way possible.”

Senior disciple Mao retracted his energy, temporarily giving up on attacking Jiang Chen. His name was actually Mao Fang, and he was the chief core disciple of the Qing Province’s Qingyi Sect. He had a formidable cultivation.
“Senior disciple Mao has spent a long time preparing to kill this giant serpent. Those who dares disturb him will be killed by us!”
The disciple named Wang said with a cruel tone.

“Keep quiet for now, don’t let that giant serpent find out we’re here. The Heavenly Tribulation is coming. This giant serpent is extremely fierce, I’m sure it’ll be able to withstand the Heavenly Tribulation and evolved into a Flood Dragon. After doing so, it will enter a weakened state temporarily, then we’ll immediately strike and kill it. Once I obtain its demon soul and blood essence, my Nine Murdering Flood Dragons will see a complete evolution, and I’ll break through to the Combat Soul realm and become one of the peerless geniuses. That will be my time to fight with those geniuses from the Martial Palace.”

A bright glow blossomed in Mao Fang’s eyes, as if he could already see his own bright future. He had spent a lot of time and effort in order to kill this Flood Dragon, and not only had he estimated the exact time for this giant serpent’s evolution, he had also arrived here early and hidden. He had also gotten help from his junior disciples.
“Look, the Heavenly Tribulation is here!”
The female disciple exclaimed.
Rumble...
The sound of thunder roared out from the dark clouds. In an instant, a thick blood red lightning bolt struck down onto the giant serpent’s head.
Roar!
The giant serpent let out a wild roar. Beams of light shot out from its body and flew toward the lightning bolt.
Rumble...

The Heavenly Tribulation’s power was incredible. In just a blink of an eye, the entire giant serpent had been covered with fierce lightning. Cracking sounds could be heard from all over its body. The serpent angrily roared out multiple times, and there was also a feeling of misery in its roars.
When the lightning disappeared, the giant serpent’s body began emitting a dark smoke, and it became weaker.
Rumble...
Thunder and lightning rumbled within the sky. A much stronger pressure covered the scene, and the second thunder bolt was currently condensing itself.

“This is the weakest form of the Heavenly Tribulation, it’s called the Minor Three Tribulation, and there will only be three lightning bolts altogether, and its power will only get stronger with each consecutive bolt. One will succeed the tribulation as long as one can withstand all three lightning bolts. However, compared to the Intermediate Six Tribulation and the Major Nine Tribulation, it’s still considered pretty weak. With this giant serpent’s ability, I think it’ll be able to succeed this Minor Three Tribulation, but it will definitely become weakened after that. These people are here for this serpent.”
Jiang Chen explained. He knew about the Heavenly Tribulation better than anyone else.

“Little Chen, after this giant serpent succeeds this Minor Three Tribulation, it will evolve into a Flood Dragon, and that will give it a small amount of a dragon’s bloodline. If you can get its demon soul and blood essence, the benefits you’ll receive will be boundless!”
Big Yellow’s eyes were twinkling with brilliance. He had begun having some understanding regarding the skill Jiang Chen was cultivating.

“You’re right. If I can obtain the demon soul and blood essence of a Flood Dragon, my Dragon Transformation skill will evolve once again, and that will give me a much stronger foundation. My cultivation will improve as well. Today’s luck is indeed good.”
A faint smile emerged on Jiang Chen’s face.
“But, I don’t think those people will give up so easily.”
Han Yan threw his glance at Mao Fang and his group.
“If they don’t provoke me, we’ll just continue our journey after we kill the Flood Dragon, but if they do provoke me... hmph!”
Jiang Chen coldly harrumphed. This Flood Dragon was his huge stroke of luck, there would only be one ending for those who tried to stop him.

When you were covered in lice, you wouldn’t feel itchy any longer; when you were up to your ears in debt, you would stop worrying. Jiang Chen had too many enemies, he had already offended the Myriad Sword Sect and the Shangguan Clan, that's why he didn’t mind offending another big sect.
Rumble...

The rumbling thunder grew louder and louder, and the dark clouds in the sky continued pushing down. Followed by another explosive roar, a red lightning bolt as thick as a dragon’s body struck onto the giant serpent. The valiant lightning appeared similar to gigantic waves as it struck toward the giant serpent’s body.
Aowuu...

The giant serpent let out a sharp blood-curdling screech. The formidable power was not the only terrifying part of the Heavenly Tribulation. What was even more shocking was the powerful Heavenly Pressure. Under the Heavenly Pressure, all existences would feel tiny, and their souls would tremble.

After the second lightning bolt descended, the giant serpent had become completely weakened. Its massive body was floating around in the sky, many of its scales had been ripped away, and blood was dripping down.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - An Emaciated Camel is Still Bigger than a Horse
paragraphs: The thunder rumbled within the skies, and the dark clouds became denser. The mighty Heavenly Pressure pushed itself down towards the giant serpent, and its massive force was wreaking havoc in the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream underneath, causing the water pond lying below to explode. The explosive sound caused those who heard it to feel as if their ears were exploding.
Soon after, the third lightning bolt had been fully condensed. This was the last bolt in the Minor Three Tribulation. Once the giant serpent succeeded, it would successfully have evolved.
But the last tribulation bolt was the most difficult to survive, it carried a force greater than the previous two tribulation bolts combined.
Rumble...
A black thunder dragon exploded out from the dark clouds while furiously roaring. It directly collided with the giant serpent’s body.
Aowuu!

The giant serpent let out a blood-curdling screech. The scales on its body were falling off, and were scattered all around the ground. It flesh was torn, and its blood was raining down from the sky. In an instant, the giant serpent was knocked away from the sky, and fell into the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream.

After this strike, the dark clouds in the sky began slowly dispersing. In just a few breaths time, the clear and bright sky had returned as if nothing had happened. But for those who had witnessed the occurrence of the Heavenly Tribulation, a breathless feeling possessed them, and their hearts were filled with extreme shock.

“The Heavenly Tribulation is really terrifying! Even when we were so far away, we could still feel the mighty Heavenly Pressure! If I had to face the Heavenly Pressure directly, perhaps I wouldn’t even be able to gather my will to fight back.”
“Only those with powerful bodies like the giant serpent can withstand the Heavenly Tribulation. If it was someone else, I’m sure he would be killed by the first lightning bolt.”

“That giant serpent has survived the Heavenly Tribulation, it has now evolved into a Flood Dragon. Soon, its cultivation will break through to the Combat Soul realm. I wonder what its current condition is like.”
A few of the disciples from the Qingyi Sect had mixed emotions. After witnessing the real power of the Heavenly Tribulation, a permanent shadow had been cast in their hearts.

“Get ready to attack. The Flood Dragon is in its weakest condition, and it’s in the middle of preparing to break through to the Combat Soul realm, this is the perfect time for us to kill it. It will fully recover once it breaks through to the Combat Soul realm, and if that really happens, killing it will be impossible.”

Mao Fang unleashed his aura and was first to start flying towards the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream. The rest of the group took out their respective combat weapons without any hesitation, and followed behind him. Even though they knew that the Flood Dragon was currently weakened, after having witnessed how strong it was when facing the Heavenly Tribulation, none of them had any confidence in dealing with it.
On the other side, Jiang Chen and Han Yan exchanged a glance, “Let’s go!”
Both men started moving. Without any hesitation, they flew toward the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream.

Right at this moment, over at the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream, the giant serpent was soaking its entire body underneath the water, leaving only its huge head above the surface of the water. Blood could be seen everywhere in the water. The giant serpent’s eyes were shut, and it was resting. On its head, a golden light was blinking, and a pointy dragon horn could be found right in the middle of its brows. This was a symbol that appeared after its evolution; the giant serpent was now a real Flood Dragon, and it possessed the noble bloodline of a dragon.

The Flood Dragon was currently in a weakened state, but at the same time, the Flood Dragon’s bloodline was healing its severely injured body. It wouldn’t take long before this Flood Dragon could break through to the Combat Soul realm and become a truly mighty demon lord.
“Let’s do this!”
Mao Fang suddenly shouted. An excited look covered his face. While staring at the Flood Dragon underneath the mountain stream, he struck out with his palm in a most formidable manner.
With an explosive sound, Mao Fang completely unleashed his aura of a Late Divine Core warrior. A dazzling palm appeared, it crashed toward the Flood Dragon like a mountain with its violent energy.
Sensing the sudden attack, the Flood Dragon who was focusing on its recovery instantly opened up its eyes. Its fury transformed into raging flames and burst out from its eyes.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon was furious. It couldn’t accept the fact that some humans were trying to kill it while it was weakened.
Even though the Flood Dragon was currently weakened, it still had formidable strength. A powerful silver white energy beam shot out from its mouth, destroying Mao Fang’s incoming attack.
Roar!

The Flood Dragon let out another furious roar, then it leapt out from the water. Its gigantic body hovered within the sky, and its body was bleeding, while its torn flesh could be seen everywhere. It stared at the humans in front of it with a pair of big eyes like a poisonous snake.
“Petty humans, how despicable are you?! How dare you launch a sneak attack while I am in a weakened condition?!”
The Flood Dragon spoke in human tongue. Its voice was so loud that it sounded like raging thunder.

“Haha, Flood Dragon, you are extremely weakened right now, you are no match for us right now. I suggest you give up all resistance, and let us kill you; this will guarantee you’ll be able to die a pleasant death.”

Mao Fan burst into laughter. He was going to get this Flood Dragon’s demon soul and blood essence no matter what. Also, since he had a strong cultivation base, he didn’t take this Flood Dragon seriously at all.
“Petty humans, I’ll definitely eat all of you!”

The Flood Dragon violently roared. After that, it turned its gigantic body around and fled far into the distance. It was in the middle of a critical moment, that’s why it didn’t want to fight these humans right now.
“Trying to run?”
How could Mao Fan give this Flood Dragon the opportunity to escape? He had been prepared for this moment! Just as the Flood Dragon turned around, Mao Fang attacked.
With great speed, Mao Fang appeared right in front of the Flood Dragon. With an imposing aura, he shouted, “Nine Murdering Flood Dragons, die now!”

Mao Fang’s arm suddenly expanded into an enormous size, as if it was transformed by his yuan energy. His arm transformed into a phantom Flood Dragon, and it attacked the real Flood Dragon in front of him.
“You’re courting death!”
The Flood Dragon was extremely angry. It swung its gigantic tail forcefully onto Mao Fang’s arms, sending violent energy ripples out that even shattered a mountain peak far underneath them.

There was a saying: an emaciated camel is still bigger than a horse. The Flood Dragon was no longer the giant serpent, it now possessed the bloodline of a Flood Dragon, which gave it a complete thorough transformation. That combined with its formidable cultivation, it wasn’t something that anyone could kill, even if it was in a weakened condition.
Obviously, Mao Fang had expected this. That’s why he had called upon his junior disciples for help.
Rumble...

Mao Fang struck once again. He unleashed a giant energy web, and figures of Flood Dragons could be found all over the web. This was an incredibly strong combat skill, and if he could obtain the blood essence of a real Flood Dragon, and study how a Flood Dragon fought, his combat skill would see a significant improvement.

The Flood Dragon was extremely brutal. The Flood Dragon unceasingly attacked with its gigantic body, and was locked in a fierce fight with Mao Fang. It was only locked in a fierce fight because it was weakened. If it was in top shape, Mao Fang would be no match for it.
“Damn it!”
The Flood Dragon cursed. It had broken through the energy’s captivity, and continued fleeing far into the distance.
“Stop the Flood Dragon!”
Mao Fang shouted. At the same time, the other six disciple disciples from the Qingyi Sect moved.
“Qingyi Grand Formation!”

The female disciple shouted. With combat weapons in their hands blowing, they worked together and unleashed a giant energy web, locking the entire area down, giving the Flood Dragon no chance to escape.

All of the Qingyi disciples were at the Divine Core realm, and they were all geniuses from the younger generation. This meant their strength was not something any ordinary Divine Core warriors could compare with. And because they were all from the same sect, they had pretty decent synergy.
“Looks like this group of people is pretty strong. Little Chen, are we going to attack?”
Han Yan asked.
“Let’s be patient; watching two tigers fighting from a hilltop is much better. I’m sure that the Flood Dragon has some other powerful abilities it can use to survive.”

Jiang Chen said with a smile on his face. He had a bad impression toward those people from the Qingyi Sect. Just now, if the Flood Dragon wasn’t facing the Heavenly Tribulation, perhaps they would have attacked Jiang Chen by now.
“Die now!”

Mao Fang took out a longsword as thing as a cicada’s wings from his storage ring. Not only was it a high-ranked combat weapon, it was a high-ranked combat weapon of the highest quality. With both hands tightly clenching onto the longsword, he slashed at the Flood Dragon.
Slash!
When the longsword hit the Flood Dragon’s body, it immediately drew a huge wound on its already torn up body. It pulled its flesh out, and caused its blood to rain down from the sky.
Roar!

When the Flood Dragon suffered from such severe injuries, it was like the last nerve in its body had been provoked. This caused its eyes to instantly turn blood red, and fury could be seen bursting out from its eyes.
“Petty humans! I’m going to kill you all! I will kill you all!”

The Flood Dragon had become furious. On top of its head, the newly grown dragon horn started shining, and as the horn became brighter and brighter, the Flood Dragon’s aggressiveness became stronger and stronger, giving those from the Qingyi Sect an extreme feeling of danger.
Swoosh!
In the next second, an energy beam that looked like a dragon shout out from the dragon horn. It seemed like an invincible blade as it pierced toward where Mao Fang stood.
There was a disciple of the Qingyi Sect stood in front of Mao Fang.
Puchi!

The energy beam’s speed was too fast. It was so fast that the disciple couldn’t even react before the energy beam pierced through his body. A huge hole instantly appeared right in the middle of his body. He died on the spot, and he didn’t even have the chance to cry out.
The energy beam didn’t seem to be slowing down after killing the man. In an instant, it arrived right in front of Mao Fang.
“Not good!”

Mao Fang felt the danger. He never thought that a desperate attack from the Flood Dragon could be so terrifying. Without hesitation, he raised the longsword in his hand and swung it toward the energy beam.
Clang!

Two massive forces clashed into each other. Mao Fang was instantly knocked back, and he was only able to stabilize his body after flying nearly 400 meters away. Impacted by the enormous energy, Mao Fang threw up a mouthful of blood on the spot, and he even had two bloody scars on his trembling palm.
Roar!

The Flood Dragon once again let out a wild roar. It slammed its gigantic tail onto one of the Qingyi disciples. The disciple let out a blood-curdling screech right before he instantly exploded into a bloody mist.
The Flood Dragon’s condition had become even worse, it was extremely weak right now, and the light on its dragon horn was completely gone.
Without bothering with the rest of the people from the Qingyi Sect, the Flood Dragon immediately flew far into the distance. It didn’t even have any thoughts about killing the remaining disciples.
“Hurry up, it’s running away!”
Big Yellow urged them.
“Don’t worry, it can’t escape from me.”

In a flash, Jiang Chen appeared in front of the Flood Dragon and stopped it from flying. Without saying anything, Jiang Chen instantly unleashed the True Dragon Palm. A huge blood red dragon claw appeared in the skies and pushed down toward the Flood Dragon.

The Flood Dragon’s expression changed dramatically. It had used up all its strength in its last desperate attack, there was absolutely no way it could defend itself from Jiang Chen’s True Dragon Palm.

sentences.text: The thunder rumbled within the skies, and the dark clouds became denser.

The mighty Heavenly Pressure pushed itself down towards the giant serpent, and its massive force was wreaking havoc in the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream underneath, causing the water pond lying below to explode.

Soon after, the third lightning bolt had been fully condensed.
This was the last bolt in the Minor Three Tribulation.
Once the giant serpent succeeded, it would successfully have evolved.
But the last tribulation bolt was the most difficult to survive, it carried a force greater than the previous two tribulation bolts combined.
Rumble...
A black thunder dragon exploded out from the dark clouds while furiously roaring.
It directly collided with the giant serpent’s body.
Aowuu!
The giant serpent let out a blood-curdling screech.
The scales on its body were falling off, and were scattered all around the ground.
It flesh was torn, and its blood was raining down from the sky.
In an instant, the giant serpent was knocked away from the sky, and fell into the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream.
After this strike, the dark clouds in the sky began slowly dispersing.
In just a few breaths time, the clear and bright sky had returned as if nothing had happened.
But for those who had witnessed the occurrence of the Heavenly Tribulation, a breathless feeling possessed them, and their hearts were filled with extreme shock.
“The Heavenly Tribulation is really terrifying!
Even when we were so far away, we could still feel the mighty Heavenly Pressure!
If I had to face the Heavenly Pressure directly, perhaps I wouldn’t even be able to gather my will to fight back.”
“Only those with powerful bodies like the giant serpent can withstand the Heavenly Tribulation.
If it was someone else, I’m sure he would be killed by the first lightning bolt.”
“That giant serpent has survived the Heavenly Tribulation, it has now evolved into a Flood Dragon.
Soon, its cultivation will break through to the Combat Soul realm.
I wonder what its current condition is like.”
A few of the disciples from the Qingyi Sect had mixed emotions.
After witnessing the real power of the Heavenly Tribulation, a permanent shadow had been cast in their hearts.
“Get ready to attack.
The Flood Dragon is in its weakest condition, and it’s in the middle of preparing to break through to the Combat Soul realm, this is the perfect time for us to kill it.
It will fully recover once it breaks through to the Combat Soul realm, and if that really happens, killing it will be impossible.”
Mao Fang unleashed his aura and was first to start flying towards the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream.
The rest of the group took out their respective combat weapons without any hesitation, and followed behind him.
Even though they knew that the Flood Dragon was currently weakened, after having witnessed how strong it was when facing the Heavenly Tribulation, none of them had any confidence in dealing with it.
On the other side, Jiang Chen and Han Yan exchanged a glance, “Let’s go!”
Both men started moving.
Without any hesitation, they flew toward the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream.
Right at this moment, over at the Serpent’s Great Mountain Stream, the giant serpent was soaking its entire body underneath the water, leaving only its huge head above the surface of the water.
Blood could be seen everywhere in the water.
The giant serpent’s eyes were shut, and it was resting.
On its head, a golden light was blinking, and a pointy dragon horn could be found right in the middle of its brows.
This was a symbol that appeared after its evolution; the giant serpent was now a real Flood Dragon, and it possessed the noble bloodline of a dragon.
The Flood Dragon was currently in a weakened state, but at the same time, the Flood Dragon’s bloodline was healing its severely injured body.
It wouldn’t take long before this Flood Dragon could break through to the Combat Soul realm and become a truly mighty demon lord.
“Let’s do this!”
Mao Fang suddenly shouted.
An excited look covered his face.
While staring at the Flood Dragon underneath the mountain stream, he struck out with his palm in a most formidable manner.
With an explosive sound, Mao Fang completely unleashed his aura of a Late Divine Core warrior.
A dazzling palm appeared, it crashed toward the Flood Dragon like a mountain with its violent energy.
Sensing the sudden attack, the Flood Dragon who was focusing on its recovery instantly opened up its eyes.
Its fury transformed into raging flames and burst out from its eyes.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon was furious.
It couldn’t accept the fact that some humans were trying to kill it while it was weakened.
Even though the Flood Dragon was currently weakened, it still had formidable strength.
A powerful silver white energy beam shot out from its mouth, destroying Mao Fang’s incoming attack.
Roar!
The Flood Dragon let out another furious roar, then it leapt out from the water.
Its gigantic body hovered within the sky, and its body was bleeding, while its torn flesh could be seen everywhere.
It stared at the humans in front of it with a pair of big eyes like a poisonous snake.

How dare you launch a sneak attack while I am in a weakened condition?!”
The Flood Dragon spoke in human tongue.
Its voice was so loud that it sounded like raging thunder.

I suggest you give up all resistance, and let us kill you; this will guarantee you’ll be able to die a pleasant death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - Reckless
paragraphs: “Petty humans!”

The Flood Dragon was furious. It struggled with all its effort, but it was unable to escape from the True Dragon Palm. Furious roars left the Flood Dragon’s mouth. It knew that its doomsday had arrived, but fury and unwillingness still burned within its heart.

It had waited so long just for today’s evolution, and if it was given just one more day, or even just half a day, it would be able to complete its evolution and break through to the Combat Soul realm. By then, it would be able to transform into a dragon and soar through the skies.
But too bad, time wasn’t on its side. It was destined to pave the way for someone else.
“Don’t resist.”

Jiang Chen said in a cold tone. The Flood Dragon was like an arrow at the end of its flight; there was no way it could withstand Jiang Chen. The Flood Dragon’s body was violently twisting under the True Dragon Palm’s enormous squeezing pressure.
“Ahh... Petty brat, how dare you take my blood essence by force?!”
The Flood Dragon furiously roared. It was suffering from intense pain right now. Jiang Chen needed to draw out its blood essence before it died. Once it lost its blood essence, it would be done for.

The blood essence was the Flood Dragon’s complete bloodline, it was the result of its evolution, the fruit that had been harvested after going through the painful Heavenly Tribulation’s punishment. But now, someone was taking it away by force. This really upset the Flood Dragon.

“Flood Dragon, I know you’ve gone through a lot in order to reach your current stage. I’d feel guilty if I killed you, so I’ll just draw out your blood essence and spare your life, I won’t take away your demon soul. With this, you’ll only lose the opportunity to evolve further, but you can still be the same demon lord.”

Jiang Chen threw out his hand and made a grabbing gesture. Immediately, an orb of blood that looked like a crystal burst out from the Flood Dragon’s mouth and fell onto his palm. After losing its blood essence, the Flood Dragon became sluggish, and its gigantic body began swaying back and forth. It looked like it could fall down from the sky at any time.
At the same time, the newly grown dragon horn that appeared after the evolution disappeared. The Flood Dragon once again returned to its previous form, and it would never be a Flood Dragon again.

But, not being able to evolve again was better than dying. Jiang Chen could easily kill this Flood Dragon and take its demon soul, but he didn’t do it, and he even gave up on the demon soul. His decision didn’t fit his approach at all.

Actually, Jiang Chen knew very well how much pain this Flood Dragon had suffered in order to evolve. There were countless serpents in this world, but not many of them could really evolve into a dragon and soar through the skies. This situation was similar to that of a human cultivator; both needed great determination to succeed. Jiang Chen really admired this. He was also a man with great determination, and since he was cultivating the Dragon Transformation skill, he would also walk the same heaven defying path, just like this giant serpent.

Furthermore, Jiang Chen had no ill feelings toward this giant serpent, and he had actually taken advantage of its perilous state. Also, this giant serpent who had lost its blood essence could no longer pose any threat to Jiang Chen. Therefore, Jiang Chen decided to spare its life.
“Leave this place.”
Jiang Chen stored away the blood essence, then he turned around to the giant serpent and spoke with a cold voice.

The giant serpent was startled upon hearing that Jiang Chen was sparing its life. It knew about its current condition very well; if Jiang Chen wanted to kill it, it wouldn’t take too much effort. He could kill it just like crushing an ant. But now, Jiang Chen had actually set it free. It just couldn’t believe it.
“If you don’t leave now, I believe those men won’t let you go.”
Jiang Chen said.
Hearing this, the giant serpent threw its angry glance at Mao Fang and his group. After that, it extended its body and flew into the distance. Soon after, it disappeared from everyone’s sight.
“Buddy, why’d you let it go? Aren’t you afraid it’ll come seek revenge in the future?”
Big Yellow looked at Jiang Chen and asked.
“I’ve given it a chance to live. If it still wants to seek revenge, I won’t give it a second chance.”

Jiang Chen said in a cruel tone. The reason why he let this giant serpent go was because he respects its great determination. But if this giant serpent really came to seek revenge, it would become Jiang Chen’s enemy, and Jiang Chen never showed his enemies any mercy.
Jiang Chen showing mercy was rare... this was actually the first time he had done so. He was a man with his own will. To kill or not to kill; it all depended on his mood.

On the other side, when the disciples from the Qingyi Sect saw the giant serpent flying far into the distance, they immediately became angry. Mao Fang was the first to dash forward. Staring at Jiang Chen with extreme anger, he said, “Bastard, you actually stole my fruits of labor, and you even let that giant serpent go!”

Mao Fang felt like he was going to throw up his blood. He had just witnessed Jiang Chen draw out the Flood Dragon’s blood essence, the thing that supposedly belonged to him. He had spent a long time preparing to get the Flood Dragon’s blood essence and demon soul. However, not only was he now injured, he had also two core disciples at the Divine Core realm, and in the end, he had paved the way for someone else. He didn’t get the blood essence, and the demon soul was gone as well.

“Get the hell of out of here you stupid bitch! Who do you think you are?! What do you mean your fruits of labor?! Does it have your name on it?! Even if it really belongs to you, can’t we rob it from you?! Do we really have to think twice before robbing someone?!”
Big Yellow stood on Jiang Chen’s shoulder as he spoke. His words could make his opponent start coughing blood.
“Damn dog, I’m definitely going to peel your skin off! Guys, I don’t care who you are, you better give me back my blood essence! If not, I’ll make you die in the most miserable way possible!”
Mao Fang’s eyes could be seen turning red. His aura had completely locked down Jiang Chen.
“Brats, the Qingyi Sect is not a sect you can afford to offend, and senior disciple Mao Fang is not someone you can mess with! You better hand over the blood essence right now!”
The disciple named Wang shouted.
“You four, chase after that giant serpent, it’s an arrow at the end of its flight. Kill it and get me its demon soul, I’ll handle these two guys.”

Mao Fang said to his four fellow disciples. Not only was he going to kill the giant serpent, he was also going to kill these two guys who came out of nowhere. Stealing his fruits of labor was really an act of courting death.
“Big Yellow.”
Jiang Chen threw a casual glance at Big Yellow. In an instant, an excited look emerged in Big Yellow’s eyes. He immediately moved, then he blocked the path in front of the four Qingyi disciples.
“You have to pass this master dog if you want to go after that giant serpent!”

Big Yellow’s head was rocking back and forth, he was showing off his pride in front of these people with his half meter long body. He was incredibly adorable right now. His current greatest weapon was his weak looks; he could pretend to be weak, then later devour his opponent. If anyone really considered Big Yellow as an adorable puppy, a devastating ending would be guaranteed.
“Damn it! I’m going to tear this damned dog to shreds!”

Disciple Wang couldn’t bear it any longer. With a swing of his arm, the whip transformed into a poisonous snake as it whipped toward Big Yellow. Big Yellow didn’t move, he just let the whip hit his head.
Slap!
Sparks flew off in all directions, and nothing happened to Big Yellow. Disciple Wang was stupefied.
“Too weak! It is master dog’s turn now!”

Big Yellow loudly roared. He leapt forward and instantly appeared right in front of disciple Wang. Although his body was still tiny, his head had suddenly become huge. With his mouth wide open, he put disciple Wang’s entire head into his mouth.
Crack! Ahhh!!
Followed by a miserable cry, Big Yellow bit off disciple Wang’s head. Blood splashed out from his neck, and he died on the spot.
“What?!”

Witnessing what just happened, the other three disciples became greatly frightened. They stared at the brutal Big Yellow, and they couldn’t help but take a few steps back. None of them could even begin to imagine why this dog was so terrifying. An Early Divine Core warrior had just been bitten to death without even a chance to fight back.

The three disciples, hearts alarmed and trembling in fear, walked behind Mao Fang. It was impossible for them to chase after the giant serpent with Big Yellow in their way. It looks like their hopes of getting the giant serpent’s demon soul was gone.

“Who gave you the audacity to kill a disciple from the Qingyi Sect? Brats, let me give you one last chance; hand over the Flood Dragon’s blood essence, then I’ll consider giving you pleasant deaths, and leave your bodies intact.”

Mao Fang said while gnashing his teeth in anger. He had found out the cultivation levels of the trio in front of him, so he didn’t take them seriously. In his mind, it was all because of his hard effort that Jiang Chen was able to capture the Flood Dragon. Because him, the Flood Dragon was like an arrow at the end of its flight; any Divine Core warrior would easily be able to kill it.
“Let me give you a chance to live; get the hell out of here immediately. I never give anyone a second chance.”
Jiang Chen indifferently said.
“Haha, what an arrogant brat. Looks like you have no idea how strong I am. Since you don’t want to hand over the blood essence, I’ll just kill you and get it myself.”

Mao Fang made an expression as if he had just heard the funniest joke in the world. He simply waved his hand and unleashed a shadowy Flood Dragon made from his Yuan energy. The shadowy Flood Dragon charged at Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen coldly harrumphed. Killing intent burst out from his eyes. Since this guy wanted to behave recklessly, he wouldn’t be polite any longer.
Jiang Chen punched out with a massive forced. His fist collided with the shadowy Flood Dragon, causing it to shatter together with a cracking sound. It was instantly destroyed by Jiang Chen.

Mao Fang was a Late Divine Core genius, he wasn’t someone those ordinary Late Divine Core warriors could compare with. If he was in top shape, Jiang Chen might have some trouble killing him, but too bad, Mao Fang was seriously wounded by the Flood Dragon’s desperate counter attack. Jiang Chen also formed another 100 Dragon Marks after leaving the Black Sect, causing his total number of Dragon Marks to become 1,100. Because of all this, Mao Fang was no match for Jiang Chen.
“What?!”
Mao Fang was greatly alarmed. This was simply unbelievable. Jiang Chen’s attack caused him to feel a tremendous pressure.
“Die now!”
Mao Fang grit his teeth in anger. He swung the longsword in his hand, unleashing an energy beam that flew toward Jiang Chen.
“Hmph!”
Jiang Chen raised his hand and unleashed the True Dragon Palm. Using the dragon claw, he grabbed Mao Fang’s longsword, then he forcefully pulled the longsword from Mao Fang’s hand.
Jiang Chen was as fast as a sudden clap of thunder. He took the longsword and turned it around, pointing the sharp edge at Mao Fang’s throat.
“Don’t-, don’t kill me! I’m from the Qingyi Sect...”
Mao Fang could sense the dangerous threat of death. But too bad, before he could finish his begging speech, the longsword penetrated into his throat.
“You-, you really killed senior disciple Mao Fang! Outrageous, who gave you the audacity to kill a disciple from the Qingyi Sect?! There is no way you can escape our hunt!
The female disciple exclaimed in great shock. Although she was threatening Jiang Chen, her voice was violently trembling.
“Big Yellow, kill them all.”
Jiang Chen didn’t look at the remaining three disciples from the Qingyi Sect, he only told Big Yellow to kill them, with an indifferent tone.
